plugins.name: Windows NetBIOS / SMB Remote Host Information Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: It was possible to obtain the network name of the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is listening on UDP port 137 or TCP port 445, and
replies to NetBIOS nbtscan or SMB requests.

Note that this plugin gathers information to be used in other plugins,
but does not itself generate a report.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows NT SCM Malformed Resource Enumeration Request DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is vulnerable to a denial of service.
plugins.description:
An 'rfpoison' packet has been sent to the remote host. This packet is
supposed to crash the 'services.exe' process, making the system
unstable.
plugins.solution:
Apply NT4 last service pack, or better, upgrade to Windows last
version.

plugins.name: Multiple Vendor Out Of Band Data DoS (WinNuke)
plugins.synopsis: The remote service is vulnerable to denial of service.
plugins.description:
It was possible to crash the remote host using the 'Winnuke' attack,
that is to send an OOB message to this port.

An attacker may use this flaw to make this host crash continuously,
preventing the system from working properly.
plugins.solution: http://support.microsoft.com/default.aspx?scid=kb;EN-US;179129

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows NetBIOS NULL Source Name Remote DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote application is prone to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be running Microsoft Windows 95/98

The version of Windows installed on the remote host is vulnerable to
the 'winpopups' or 'rfparalyze' denial of service. A user can leverage
this issue to crash the remote host.

Note that Nessus crashed the remote host to test this flaw.
plugins.solution: No patch available. Filter incoming traffic to this port.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Log In Possible
plugins.synopsis: It was possible to log into the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a Microsoft Windows operating system or
Samba, a CIFS/SMB server for Unix. It was possible to log into it
using one of the following accounts :

- Guest account
- Supplied credentials
- Randomly generated credentials
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Shares Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to enumerate remote network shares.
plugins.description:
By connecting to the remote host, Nessus was able to enumerate the
network share names.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Shares Access
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to access a network share.
plugins.description:
The remote has one or more Windows shares that can be accessed through
the network with the given credentials.

Depending on the share rights, it may allow an attacker to read /
write confidential data.
plugins.solution:
To restrict access under Windows, open Explorer, do a right click on
each share, go to the 'sharing' tab, and click on 'permissions'.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB LanMan Pipe Server Listing Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to obtain network information.
plugins.description:
It was possible to obtain the browse list of the remote Windows system
by sending a request to the LANMAN pipe. The browse list is the list
of the nearest Windows systems of the remote host.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB LsaQueryInformationPolicy Function NULL Session Domain SID Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: It was possible to obtain the domain SID.
plugins.description:
By making or emulating a call to LsaQueryInformationPolicy(), it
was possible to obtain the domain SID (Security Identifier).

The domain SID can then be used to get the list of users of the
domain.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: SMB Use Domain SID to Enumerate Users
plugins.synopsis: Nessus was able to enumerate domain users.
plugins.description:
Using the domain security identifier (SID), Nessus was able to
enumerate the domain users on the remote Windows system.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry Remotely Accessible
plugins.synopsis: Access the remote Windows Registry.
plugins.description:
It was possible to access the remote Windows Registry using the login
/ password combination used for the Windows local checks (SMB tests).
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : NT4 Service Pack Version Detection
plugins.synopsis:
It was possible to determine the service pack installed on the remote
system.
plugins.description:
Nessus was able to determine the Service Pack version of the Windows
NT system by reading the following registry key :

HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\CSDVersion
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Guessable User Credentials
plugins.synopsis: Credentials for the remote Windows host can be discovered.
plugins.description:
This script attempts to log into the remote host using several login /
password combinations.
plugins.solution: Have the affected user(s) choose a good password.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Autologon Enabled
plugins.synopsis: Anyone can logon to the remote system.
plugins.description:
This script determines whether the autologon feature is enabled. This
feature allows an intruder to log into the remote host as
DefaultUserName with the password DefaultPassword.
plugins.solution:
Delete the keys AutoAdminLogon and DefaultPassword under
HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Remote PDC/BDC Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote system is a Domain Controller.
plugins.description:
The remote host seems to be a Primary Domain Controller or a Backup
Domain Controller.

This can be verified by the value of the registry key 'ProductType'
under 'HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\ProductOptions'.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Schedule Key Permission Weakness Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis: Local users can elevate their privileges.
plugins.description:
The registry key SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\Schedule is
writeable by users who are not in the admin group.

Since the scheduler runs with SYSTEM privileges, this allow a
malicious user to gain these privileges on this system.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Registry HKLM_LOCAL_MACHINE Permissions
plugins.synopsis: System settings are writable by non admin.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKEY_LOCAL_MACHINE is writeable by users who are not
in the admin group.

This allows these users to create a lot of keys on that machine, thus
they can probably to get admin easily.

Such a configuration probably means that the system has been
compromised.
plugins.solution:
use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry Not Fully Accessible Detection
Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Winlogon Key Permission Weakness
plugins.synopsis: Local users can gain SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows
NT\CurrentVersion\Winlogon is writeable by users who are not in the
admin group.

This key contains a value which defines which program should be run
when a user logs on.

As this program runs in the SYSTEM context, the users who have the
right to change the value of this key can gain more privileges on this
host.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Key Permission Weakness Admin Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis: Local users can gain administrator privileges.
plugins.description:
The following keys contain the name of the program that shall be
started when the computer starts. The users who have the right to
modify them can easily make the admin run a Trojan program that will
give them admin privileges.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

  - Admin group  : Full Control
  - System       : Full Control
  - Everyone     : Read

Make sure that 'Power Users' do not have any special privilege for
this key.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Winreg Registry Key Detection
plugins.synopsis: Everyone can access the remote registry.
plugins.description:
The registry key
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurePipeServers\Winreg is
missing.

This key allows you to define what can be viewed in the registry by
non administrators.
plugins.solution:
Install Service Pack 3 (SP3) if not done already, and create the
SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurePipeServers\Winreg\AllowedPaths
registry key. Under this key, create the value 'Machine' as a
REG_MULTI_SZ and put in it what you allow to be browsed remotely.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Key Permissions Path Subversion Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis: Local users can gain SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.description:
Some SYSTEM registry keys can be written by non administrator.

These keys contain paths to common programs and DLLs. If a user can
change a path, then he may put a trojan program into another location
(say C:/temp) and point to it.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: MS00-029: NT IP Fragment Reassembly Patch Not Applied (jolt2) (259728)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote host.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'IP Fragment Reassembly' vulnerability has not
been applied on the remote Windows host.

This vulnerability allows an attacker to send malformed packets, which
will utilize 100% of the computer CPU, making it nearly unusable for
the legitimate users.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches.

plugins.name: MS00-036: NT ResetBrowser frame & HostAnnouncement flood patch (262694)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to partially crash the remote host.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'ResetBrowser Frame' and the 'HostAnnouncement
flood' has not been applied.

The first of these vulnerabilities allows anyone to shut down the
network browser of this host at will.

The second vulnerability allows an attacker to add thousands of bogus
entries in the master browser, which will consume most of the network
bandwidth as a side effect.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : SFCDisable Key Permission Weakness
plugins.synopsis: Local users have full privileges on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows
NT\WinLogon\SFCDisable has its value set to a value other than 0 or 4.

Any value other than 0 or 4 disables the Windows File Protection,
which allows any user on the remote host to view / modify any file he
wants.

This probably means that this host has been compromised.
plugins.solution: Set the value of this key to 0. You should reinstall this host

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Service Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to enumerate remote services.
plugins.description:
This plugin implements the SvcOpenSCManager() and SvcEnumServices()
calls to obtain, using the SMB protocol, the list of active and
inactive services of the remote host.

An attacker may use this feature to gain better knowledge of the
remote host.
plugins.solution:
To prevent the listing of the services from being obtained, you should
either have tight login restrictions, so that only trusted users can
access your host, and/or you should filter incoming traffic to this
port.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Alerter Service Social Engineering Weakness
Microsoft Windows Messenger Service Social Engineering Weakness
MS00-047: NetBIOS Name Server Protocol Spoofing patch (269239)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to spoof the NetBIOS name.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'NetBIOS Name Server Protocol Spoofing' problem
has not been applied.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user to make this host think
that its name has already been taken on the network, thus preventing
it from functioning properly as an SMB server (or client).
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-053: Service Control Manager Named Pipe Impersonation patch (269523)
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is prone to a privilege escalation attack.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Service Control Manager Named Pipe Impersonation'
problem has not been applied.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user, who has the right to log on
this host locally, to gain additional privileges.
plugins.solution:
Apply the appropriate patches from MS00-053 or apply the latest
Windows service pack.

plugins.name: MS00-052: Relative Shell Path patch (269049)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Relative Shell Path' vulnerability has not been
applied.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user who can write to the remote
system root to cause the code of malicious user's choice to be
executed by the users who will interactively log into this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-062: Local Security Policy Corruption (269609)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can corrupt the remote system.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Local Security Policy Corruption' problem has not
been applied.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user to corrupt parts of a Windows
2000 system's local security policy, which could prevent this host from
communicating with other hosts in this domain.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-065: Still Image Service Privilege Escalation patch (272736)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate privileges.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Still Image Service Privilege Escalation' problem
has not been applied.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user, who has the right to log
on this host locally, to gain additional privileges on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a patch for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-066: Malformed RPC Packet patch (272303)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote host.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Malformed RPC Packet' problem has not been
applied.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user to launch a denial of
service against this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-067: Telnet Client NTLM Authentication Vulnerability (272743)
plugins.synopsis: It may be possible to steal user credentials.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Telnet Client NTLM Authentication' problem has
not been applied.

This vulnerability may, under certain circumstances, allow a malicious
user to obtain cryptographically protected login credentials from
another user.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a patch for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-070: LPC and LPC Ports Vulnerabilities patch (266433)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate privileges.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Multiple LPC and LPC Ports Vulnerabilities' has
not been applied on the remote Windows host.

These vulnerabilities allow an attacker gain privileges on the remote
host, or to crash it remotely.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Windows 2000 Service Pack Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote system has the latest service pack installed.
plugins.description:
By reading the registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows
NT\CurrentVersion\CSDVersion it was possible to determine the
Service Pack version of the remote Windows 2000 system.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : WinVNC's Key Permissions
plugins.synopsis: Local users can connect to the system remotely.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKLM\Software\ORL\WinVNC3 is writeable and/or
readable by users who are not in the admin group.

This key contains the VNC password of this host, as well as other
configuration setup.

As this program allows remote access to this computer with the
privileges of the currently logged on users, you should fix this
problem.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : No access

plugins.name: MS00-089: Domain Account Lockout Vulnerability (274372)
plugins.synopsis: A security update is missing on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'domain account lockout' problem has not been
applied.

This vulnerability allows a user to bypass the domain account lockout
policy, and hence attempt to brute-force a user account.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-091: Incomplete TCP/IP Packet Vulnerability (199346)
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is vulnerable to a denial of service attack.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'incomplete TCP/IP packet' problem has not been
applied.

This vulnerability allows a user to prevent this host from communicating
with the network.
plugins.solution:
Apply the appropriate patches from MS00-091 or apply the latest Windows
service pack.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : NT RAS Administration Registry Key Permission Weakness Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis: Local users can gain additional privileges.
plugins.description:
This script checks whether the following key can be modified by
non-admins :

HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\RAS

Write access to this key allows an unprivileged user to gain
additional privileges.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: MS01-003: Winsock2ProtocolCatalogMutex Mutex Local DoS (279336)
plugins.synopsis:
A bug in the remote operating system allows a local user to disable
the network functions of the remote host.
plugins.description:
By default, Windows NT sets weak permissions on the Winsock mutex.  A
local user without any privilege may abuse these permissions to lock
the mutex indefinitely and, therefore, disrupt the network operations of
the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for NT 4.0.

plugins.name: MS01-009: Malformed PPTP Packet Stream Remote DoS (283001)
plugins.synopsis:
A flaw in the remote PPTP implementation could allow an attacker to
cause a denial of service.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Malformed PPTP Packet Stream' problem has not
been applied.  This hotfix corrects a memory leak in Windows NT PPTP
implementation that could cause it to use all the resources of the
remote host.

An attacker could use this flaw by sending malformed PPTP packets to the
remote host until no more memory is available.  This would result in a
denial of service of the remote service or the whole system.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT 4.0.

plugins.name: MS01-011 / MS01-036: LDAP over SSL Arbitrary User Password Modification (287397 / 299687)
plugins.synopsis:
A bug in Windows 2000 may allow an attacker to change the password of
a third-party user.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows 2000 contains a bug in its LDAP
implementation that fails to validate the permissions of a user
requesting to change the password of a third-party user.

An attacker may exploit this vulnerability to gain unauthorized access
to the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS00-086: Webserver file request parsing (277873)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Webserver file request parsing' problem has not
been applied.

This vulnerability can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands
through the remote IIS server.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for IIS 4.0 and 5.0.

plugins.name: MS01-025: Index Server Multiple Vulnerabilities (294472 / 296185)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'Malformed request to index server' problem has not
been applied.

This vulnerability can allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on
the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Index Server 2.0 and
Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS01-008: NTLMSSP Local Privilege Escalation (280119)
plugins.synopsis:
A bug in the remote operating system allows a local user to elevate
privileges.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'NTLMSSP Privilege Escalation' problem has not
been applied.  This hotfix corrects a problem in Windows NT that could
allow a local process to execute code with the privileges of the
NTLMSSP service provider.

This vulnerability allows a malicious user, who has the right to log
on this host locally, to gain additional privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for NT 4.0.

plugins.name: MS01-046: IrDA Driver Malformed Packet Remote DoS (252795)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to remotely shutdown the server.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'IrDA access violation patch' problem has not been
applied.

This vulnerability can allow an attacker who is physically near the
W2K host to shut it down using a remote control.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a patch for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: DCE Services Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: A DCE/RPC service is running on the remote host.
plugins.description:
By sending a Lookup request to the portmapper (TCP 135 or epmapper
PIPE) it was possible to enumerate the Distributed Computing
Environment (DCE) services running on the remote port. Using this
information it is possible to connect and bind to each service by
sending an RPC request to the remote port/pipe.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB NativeLanManager Remote System Information Disclosure
plugins.synopsis:
It was possible to obtain information about the remote operating
system.
plugins.description:
Nessus was able to obtain the remote operating system name and version
(Windows and/or Samba) by sending an authentication request to port
139 or 445. Note that this plugin requires SMB to be enabled on the
host.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Samba NETBIOS Name Traversal Arbitrary Remote File Creation
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary files may be overwritten on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, allows
creation of arbitrary remote files. 

This vulnerability allows an attacker to overwrite arbitrary files by
supplying an arbitrarily formed NetBIOS machine name to this server,
and to potentially become root on the remote server. 

An attacker does not need any privileges to exploit this flaw.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.0.10 or 2.2.0a

plugins.name: MS01-048: RPC Endpoint Mapper Malformed Request DoS (305399)
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is affected by a denial of service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The hotfix for the 'RPC Endpoint Mapper Service on NT 4 has not been
applied' problem has not been applied.

Because the endpoint mapper runs within the RPC service itself,
exploiting this vulnerability would cause the RPC service to
fail, with the attendant loss of any RPC-based services the server
offers, as well as potential loss of some COM functions.  Normal
service could be restored by rebooting the server.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a patch for Windows NT 4.0.

plugins.name: MS01-059: Unchecked Buffer in Universal Plug and Play can Lead to System Compromise (315000)
plugins.synopsis:
The Universal Plug and Play service on the remote host is prone to
denial of service and buffer overflow attacks.
plugins.description:
Using a specially crafted NOTIFY directive, a remote attacker can
cause code to run in the context of the Universal Plug and Play (UPnP)
subsystem or possibly launch a denial of service attack against the
affected host.

Note that, under Windows XP, the UPnP subsystem operates with SYSTEM
privileges.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 98, 98SE, ME, and
XP.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB LsaQueryInformationPolicy Function SID Enumeration
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to obtain the host SID for the remote host.
plugins.description:
By emulating the call to LsaQueryInformationPolicy(), it was possible
to obtain the host SID (Security Identifier).

The host SID can then be used to get the list of local users.
plugins.solution:
You can prevent anonymous lookups of the host SID by setting the
'RestrictAnonymous' registry setting to an appropriate value.

Refer to the 'See also' section for guidance.

plugins.name: SMB Use Host SID to Enumerate Local Users
plugins.synopsis: Nessus was able to enumerate local users.
plugins.description:
Using the host security identifier (SID), Nessus was able to enumerate
local users on the remote Windows system.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: MS02-005: MSIE 5.01 5.5 6.0 Cumulative Patch (890923)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The Cumulative Patch for IE is not applied on the remote host.

Impact of vulnerability : Run code of attacker's choice.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for the Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS02-006: Malformed SNMP Management Request Remote Overflow (314147)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
A buffer overrun is present in the SNMP service on the remote host.  By
sending a malformed management request, an attacker could cause a denial
of service and possibly cause code to run on the system in the
LocalSystem context.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-008: XML Core Services patch (318203)
plugins.synopsis: Local files can be retrieved through the web client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Internet Explorer that could
allow an attacker to read local files on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to lure a victim on the
remote system into visiting a rogue website.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for the Windows NT, 2000 and
XP.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Domain User Information
plugins.synopsis: Nessus was able to retrieve domain user information.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to retrieve
information for each domain user.

Note that this plugin itself does not issue a report and only serves
to store information about each domain user in the KB for further
checks.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows User Aliases List
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to retrieve users aliases.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials it was possible to retrieve the
list of groups each user belong to.
Aliases are stored in the KB for further checks.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows User Groups List
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to retrieve users groups.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials it was possible to retrieve the
list of groups each user belongs to.
Groups are stored in the KB for further checks.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Users Information : Automatically Disabled Accounts
plugins.synopsis: At least one user account has been automatically disabled.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list user accounts
that have been automatically disabled. These accounts may have been
disabled for security reasons or due to brute-force attack attempts.
plugins.solution: Delete accounts that are no longer needed.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Users Information : Can't Change Password
plugins.synopsis: At least one user can not change his or her password.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list users who can
not change their own passwords.
plugins.solution: Allow or require users to change their passwords regularly.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Users Information : Disabled Accounts
plugins.synopsis: At least one user account has been disabled.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list user accounts
that have been disabled.
plugins.solution: Delete accounts that are no longer needed.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Users Information : Never Changed Password
plugins.synopsis: At least one user has never changed his or her password.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list users who have
never changed their passwords.
plugins.solution: Allow or require users to change their passwords regularly.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Users Information : User Has Never Logged In
plugins.synopsis: At least one user has never logged into his or her account.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list users who have
never logged into their accounts.
plugins.solution: Delete accounts that are not needed.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Users Information : Passwords Never Expire
plugins.synopsis: At least one user has a password that never expires.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list users that are
enabled and whose passwords never expire.
plugins.solution: Allow or require users to change their passwords regularly.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Account Operators' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Account Operators' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Account Operators' group. Members of this group can
create or modify local user accounts but can not modify or create
administrative accounts or edit user rights.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Administrators' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Administrators' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Administrators' group. Members of this group have
complete access to the remote system.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Server Operators' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Server Operators' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Server Operators' group. Members of this group can
perform most common administrative tasks.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Backup Operators' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Backup Operators' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Backup Operators' group. Members of this group can logon
to the remote host and perform backup operations (read/write files)
but have no administrative rights.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Print Operators' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Print Operators' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Print Operators' group. Members of this group can manage
printers within a Windows Domain or shutdown a server.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Replicator' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Replicator' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Replicator' group. Members of this group can replicate
(or copy) files or directories within a domain.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Guest Account Belongs to a Group
plugins.synopsis: The 'Guest' account has excessive privileges.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to determine that the
'Guest' user belongs to groups other than 'Guests' (RID 546) or
'Domain Guests' (RID 514). Guest users should not have any additional
privileges.
plugins.solution:
Edit the local or domain policy to restrict group membership for the
guest account.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 'Domain Administrators' Group User List
plugins.synopsis: There is at least one user in the 'Domain Administrators' group.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, it is possible to extract the member
list of the 'Domain Administrators' group. Members of this group have
complete access to the Windows Domain.
plugins.solution: Verify that each member of the group should have this type of access.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Local User Information
plugins.synopsis: Nessus was able to retrieve local user information.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to retrieve
information for each local user.

Note that this plugin itself does not issue a report and only serves
to store information about each local user in the KB for further
checks.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Local Users Information : Automatically Disabled Accounts
plugins.synopsis: At least one local user account has been automatically disabled.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list local user
accounts that have been automatically disabled. These accounts may
have been disabled for security reasons or due to brute-force attack
attempts.
plugins.solution: Delete accounts that are no longer needed.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Local Users Information : Can't Change Password
plugins.synopsis: At least one local user cannot change his or her password.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list local users
who can not change their own passwords.
plugins.solution: Allow or require users to change their passwords regularly.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Local Users Information : Disabled Accounts
plugins.synopsis: At least one local user account has been disabled.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list local user
accounts that have been disabled.
plugins.solution: Delete accounts that are no longer needed.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Local Users Information : Never Changed Passwords
plugins.synopsis: At least one local user has never changed his or her password.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list local users
who have never changed their passwords.
plugins.solution: Allow or require users to change their passwords regularly.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Local Users Information : User Has Never Logged In
plugins.synopsis: At least one local user has never logged into his or her account.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list local users
who have never logged into their accounts.
plugins.solution: Delete accounts that are not needed.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows - Local Users Information : Passwords Never Expire
plugins.synopsis: At least one local user has a password that never expires.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was able to list local users
that are enabled and whose passwords never expire.
plugins.solution: Allow or require users to change their passwords regularly.

plugins.name: SMB Scope
MS02-009: IE VBScript Handling patch (318089)
plugins.synopsis: Local files can be retrieved through the web client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Internet Explorer that may
allow an attacker to read local files on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to lure a victim on the
remote system into visiting a rogue website.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for the Windows NT, 2000 and
XP.

plugins.name: MS02-018: Cumulative Patch for Internet Information Services (327696)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
server.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains multiple flaws in the Internet
Information Service (IIS), such as heap overflow, DoS, and XSS that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host
with SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for IIS 4.0, 5.0, 5.1.

plugins.name: MS02-017: MUP overlong request kernel overflow Patch (311967)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in Multiple UNC Provider
(MUP) service that could allow a local user to execute arbitrary code on
the remote host with SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-016: Opening Group Policy Files (318089)
plugins.synopsis: A user can block access to GPO deployment.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the Group Policy
Object (GPO) access right of Active Directory that could allow a user to
prevent the GPO to be applied to other users.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS02-024: Windows Debugger flaw can Lead to Elevated Privileges (320206)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a flaw in the Windows Debugger that could
allow a local user to elevate his privileges.

To exploit this vulnerability, a user needs to send a specially crafted
code to the Debbuging handler to execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM
privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Service Detection
plugins.synopsis: A file / print sharing service is listening on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote service understands the CIFS (Common Internet File System)
or Server Message Block (SMB) protocol, used to provide shared access
to files, printers, etc between nodes on a network.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: MS02-029: Windows RAS Local Overflow (318138)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
An overflow in the RAS phonebook service allows a local user to execute
code on the system with the privileges of LocalSystem.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-042: Flaw in Network Connection Manager Could Enable Privilege Elevation (326886)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a flaw in the Network Connection Manager that
may allow a local user to elevate his privileges.

To exploit this vulnerability, a user needs to send a specially- crafted
code to the Network Manager handle to execute arbitrary code with the
privileges of the SYSTEM.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: CA BrightStor ARCserve Backup Agent Credential Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: Backup share can be accessed without authentication.
plugins.description:
The remote host has an accessible ARCSERVE$ share.

Several versions of ARCserve store the backup agent username and
password in a plaintext file on this share.

An attacker may use this flaw to obtain the password file of the
remote backup agent, and use it to gain privileges on this host.
plugins.solution:
Limit access to this share to the backup account and domain
administrator.

plugins.name: MS02-045: Microsoft Windows SMB Protocol SMB_COM_TRANSACTION Packet Remote Overflow DoS (326830) (uncredentialed check)
Samba enum_csc_policy Data Structure Termination Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis: The remote Samba server may be affected by a buffer overflow issue.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is
vulnerable to a possible buffer overflow because it fails to properly
terminate the 'enum_csc_policy' struct.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.2.5 or later.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : XP Service Pack Detection
plugins.synopsis:
It was possible to determine the service pack installed on the remote
system.
plugins.description:
Nessus was able to determine the Service Pack version of the Windows
XP system by reading the following registry key :

HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows NT\CurrentVersion\CSDVersion
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: MS02-025: Exchange 2000 Exhaust CPU Resources (320436)
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to launch a denial of service attack against the remote
mail server.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Exchange Server 2000.  The remote version
of this software contains a flaw that allows an attacker to cause a
temporary denial of service.

To do this, the attacker needs to send an email message with malformed
attributes.  CPU utilization will spike at 100% until the message has
been processed.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Exchange 2000.

plugins.name: MS02-048: Flaw in Certificate Enrollment Control Could Allow Deletion of Digital Certificates (323172)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to delete digital certificates on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Certificate Enrollment
control that may allow an attacker to delete certificates.

To exploit this vulnerability an attacker must create a rogue web server
with SSL and lure the user to visit this site.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-050: Certificate Validation Flaw Could Enable Identity Spoofing (328145)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to spoof user identities.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the CryptoAPI that could allow an
attacker to spoof the identity of another user with malformed SSL
certificates.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-051: Cryptographic Flaw in RDP Protocol can Lead to Information Disclosure (324380)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote desktop service.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Remote Desktop protocol /
service that could allow an attacker to crash the remote service and
cause the system to stop responding.  Another vulnerability could allow
an attacker to disclose information.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-055: Unchecked Buffer in Windows Help Facility Could Enable Code Execution (323255)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the HTML Helpfacility ActiveX
control module that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on
the remote host by constructing a malicious web page and enticing a
victim to visit it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-054: Unchecked Buffer in File Decompression Functions Could Lead to Code Execution (329048)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Explorer.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of Windows that has a security flaw
in the compressed files (ZIP) implementation.  An attacker can exploit
this flaw by sending a malicious zip file to the remote user.  When the
user opens the file with Explorer, arbitrary code will be executed.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: Samba Encrypted Password String Conversion Decryption Overflow
plugins.synopsis: Remote code can be executed on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is vulnerable
to a bug in the length checking for encrypted password change requests 
from clients. A client could potentially send an encrypted password, 
which, when decrypted with the old hashed password could be used as a
buffer overrun attack on the stack of smbd.
plugins.solution: upgrade to Samba 2.2.7

plugins.name: MS02-052: Flaw in Microsoft VM Could Allow Code Execution (810030)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the VM.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a Microsoft VM machine that has a bug
in its bytecode verifier that could allow a remote attacker to execute
arbitrary code on this host, with the privileges of the SYSTEM.

To exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need to send a malformed
applet to a user on this host, and have him execute it. The malicious
applet would then be able to execute code outside the sandbox of the VM.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-063: Unchecked Buffer in PPTP Implementation Could Enable DOS Attacks (329834)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote system.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in its PPTP
implementation.  If the remote host is configured to act as a PPTP
server, a remote attacker can send a specially crafted packet to corrupt
the kernel memory and crash the remote system.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2000.

plugins.name: MS02-071: WM_TIMER Message Handler Privilege Elevation (328310)
plugins.synopsis: Local users can elevate their privileges on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the handling of
WM_TIMER messages for interactive processes that could allow a local
user to execute arbitrary code on the remote host with the SYSTEM
privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, XP and 2000.

plugins.name: MS02-072: Unchecked Buffer in XP Shell Could Enable System Compromise (329390)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Windows
Shell.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the handling of audio
files (MP3, WMA) in the Windows Shell component, that could allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host with SYSTEM
privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP.

plugins.name: MS03-001: Unchecked buffer in Locate Service (810833)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The Microsoft Locate service is a name server that maps logical names
to network-specific names.

There is a security vulnerability in this server that allows an
attacker to execute arbitrary code in it by sending a specially
crafted packet to it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-070: Flaw in SMB Signing Could Enable Group Policy to be Modified (329170)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to send unsigned SMB packets.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the SMB signing
implementation.  SMB signing is used to sign each packets sent between a
client and a server to protect them against man-in-the-middle attacks.

If the Domain policy is configured to force usage of SMB signing, it is
possible for an attacker to downgrade the communication to disable SMB
signing and try to launch man-in-the-middle attacks.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2000.

plugins.name: Microsoft SQL Server Detection (credentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has a database server installed.
plugins.description:
Nessus has detected one or more installs of Microsoft SQL server by
examining the registry and file systems on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Ensure the latest service pack and hotfixes are installed.

plugins.name: MS03-005: Unchecked Buffer in XP Redirector (810577)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a buffer overflow in the Windows
Redirector service that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary
code on the remote host with SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP.

plugins.name: MS02-060: Flaw in WinXP Help center could enable file deletion (328940)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary files can be deleted on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
There is a security vulnerability in the remote Windows XP Help and
Support Center which can be exploited by an attacker to delete arbitrary
files on this host.

To do so, an attacker needs to create malicious web pages that must be
visited by the owner of the remote system.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2000.

plugins.name: MS02-045: Unchecked buffer in Network Share Provider (326830)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote host.
plugins.description:
Due to a flaw in Microsoft's SMB implementation, the remote host is
vulnerable to a denial of service attack.  By sending a specially
crafted packet request, an attacker could launch a denial of service,
causing the affected host to crash.

Note that this vulnerability is not exploitable without credentials
unless anonymous access has been disabled.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-040 / MS03-033: Unchecked buffer in MDAC Function (326573 / 823718)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through MDAC
server.
plugins.description:
The remote Microsoft Data Access Component (MDAC) server is vulnerable
to a flaw that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on this
host, provided he can load and execute a database query on this
server.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for MDAC 2.6, 2.7 and 2.8.

plugins.name: MS02-032: Cumulative patch for Windows Media Player (320920)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the media
player.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows Media Player is affected by various flaws :

  - A remote attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code
    when sending a badly formed file.

  - A local attacker may gain SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP.

plugins.name: MS02-030: Unchecked Buffer in SQLXML (321911)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
SQL server.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running SQLXML. There are flaws in this application
that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code on this
host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS02-026: ASP.NET Worker Process StateServer Mode Remote Overflow (322289)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote ASP.NET installation might be vulnerable to a buffer
overflow when an application enables StateServer mode.

An attacker could use it to cause a denial of service or run arbitrary
code with the same privileges as the process being exploited
(typically an unprivileged account).
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for ASP.NET.

plugins.name: MS02-014: Unchecked buffer in Windows Shell (313829)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate privileges.
plugins.description:
The Windows shell of the remote host has an unchecked buffer that can
be exploited by a local attacker to run arbitrary code on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: MS02-003: WinReg Remote Registry Key Manipulation (316056)
plugins.synopsis: Local users can elevate their privileges.
plugins.description:
The key HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurePipeServers\winreg
is writeable by non-administrators.

The installation software of Microsoft Exchange sets this key to a
world-writeable mode.

Local users could use this misconfiguration to escalate their
privileges on this host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for the Windows NT, 2000 and
XP.

plugins.name: MS02-035: MS SQL Installation may leave passwords on system (263968)
plugins.synopsis:
It may be possible to get the remote SQL Server's administrator
password.
plugins.description:
The installation process for the remote MS SQL Server left files named
'setup.iss' on the remote host. These files contain the password
assigned to the 'sa' account of the remote database.

An attacker who manages to view these files may be able to leverage
this issue to gain full administrative access to the application.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for SQL Server 7 and 2000.

plugins.name: Flash Player < 6.0.79.0 Multiple Unspecified Overflows
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has a browser plugin that is prone to buffer
overflow attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host has an old version of the Flash Player plugin
installed. 

An attacker may use this flaw to construct a malicious website with a
badly-formed Flash animation that, when viewed using a vulnerable
version of the software, will cause a buffer overflow and allow for
arbitrary code execution subject to the plugin user's privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 6.0.79.0 or later.

plugins.name: MS02-021: Word Mail Reply Arbitrary Script Execution (321804)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Word.
plugins.description:
Outlook 2000 and 2002 provide the option to use Microsoft Word as the
email editor when creating and editing email in RTF or HTML.

There is a flaw in some versions of Word that could allow an attacker to
execute arbitrary code when the user replies to a specially formed
message using Word.

An attacker could use this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000 and 2002.

plugins.name: MS02-013: Cumulative VM Update (300845)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the VM.
plugins.description:
The Microsoft VM is a virtual machine for the Win32 operating
environment.

There are numerous security flaws in the remote Microsoft VM that could
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To exploit these flaws, an attacker would need to set up a malicious web
site with a rogue Java applet and lure the user of this host to visit
it.  The Java applet could then execute arbitrary commands on this
host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft VM is no longer supported, and previous updates are no no
longer available.  Upgrade to an actively supported product.

plugins.name: Virus Infection Detection (deprecated)
MS00-035: MS SQL7.0 Service Pack may leave passwords on system (263968)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote SQL server is vulnerable to an information disclosure
attack.
plugins.description:
The installation process of the remote MS SQL server left a file named
'sqlsp.log' on the remote host. This file contains the password
assigned to the 'sa' account of the remote database.

An attacker may use this flaw to gain administrative access to the
database server.
plugins.solution: Apply the appropriate patches from MS00-035 or upgrade MS SQL.

plugins.name: MS02-031: Cumulative patches for Excel and Word for Windows (324458)
plugins.synopsis:
A Microsoft Office application installed on the remote host is
affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The versions of Microsoft Word and Excel installed on the remote
host are missing a security update. They are, therefore, affected by
multiple vulnerabilities :

  - A security bypass vulnerability exists in Excel due to
    improper handling of formatted inline macros that are
    attached to objects within a workbook. An
    unauthenticated, remote attacker can exploit this, by
    convincing a user to open a specially crafted workbook,
    to execute macros outside the constraints of the Macro
    Security Model. (CVE-2002-0616)

  - A security bypass vulnerability exists in Excel due to
    improper handling of macros in a workbook when it is
    opened through a hyperlink associated with a drawing
    shape in another workbook. An unauthenticated, remote
    attacker can exploit this, by convincing a user to open
    a specially crafted workbook, to execute macros outside
    the constraints of the Macro Security Model.
    (CVE-2002-0617)

  - A flaw exists in the Macro Security Model in Excel due
    to a failure to correctly detect the presence of HTML
    scripting within an Excel workbook that contains an XSL
    stylesheet. An unauthenticated, remote attacker can
    exploit this, by convincing a user to open a specially
    crafted file, to execute arbitrary HTML scripts.
    (CVE-2002-0618)

  - A flaw exists in Word when opening Mail Merge documents
    that have been saved in HTML format. An unauthenticated,
    remote attacker can exploit this, by convincing a user
    to open a specially crafted document, to execute
    arbitrary VBA code in Access. (CVE-2002-0619)
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Excel 2000, Excel 2002,
and Word 2002.

plugins.name: Gupta SQLBase EXECUTE Command Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis: The remote SQL server is affected by a buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the Gupta SQLBase server which
is older than or equal to 8.1.0.

An error in the 'Execute' command makes it possible to trigger a
buffer overflow by supplying more than 700 characters as the
parameter. A remote, authenticated attacker, exploiting this flaw, can
crash the affected service or potentially execute arbitrary code with
SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: There is no known solution at this time.

plugins.name: MS02-001: Trusted Domain SID Remote Privilege Escalation (311401)
Samba < 2.2.8 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code may be run on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is vulnerable
to a remote buffer overflow when receiving specially crafted SMB 
fragment packets.

An attacker needs to be able to access at least one share to exploit 
this flaw.

In addition, it is reported that Samba contains a flaw
related to the handling of .reg files that may allow
a local user to overwrite arbitrary file.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.2.8.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.03 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by 
multiple flaws.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host is vulnerable to
various security flaws, ranging from cross-site scripting to buffer
overflows. 

To exploit them, an attacker would need to set up a rogue website,
then lure a user of this host visit it using Opera.  He would then be
able to execute arbitrary code on this host.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.03 or newer.

plugins.name: MS03-007: Unchecked Buffer in ntdll.dll (815021)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a buffer overflow in the Windows
kernel, that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with SYSTEM privileges.

For example this vulnerability can be exploited through the WebDAV
component of IIS 5.0.

A public exploit is available.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS03-008: Flaw in Windows Script Engine (814078)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is vulnerable to a flaw in the Windows Script Engine,
that provides Windows with the ability to execute script code.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to lure one user on this
host to visit a rogue website or to send a user an HTML email with a
malicious code in it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: ICQ Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is an instant messaging client installed on the remote Windows
host.
plugins.description:
ICQ is installed on the remote host. ICQ is an instant messaging
client for Windows that also includes some peer-to-peer file sharing
features. As such, it may not be suitable for use in a business
environment.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if its use does not agree with your
organization's security and/or acceptable use policies.

plugins.name: Kazaa on Windows Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is a peer-to-peer file sharing application on the remote Windows
host.
plugins.description:
Kazaa, a peer-to-peer file sharing application is installed on the
remote host.
plugins.solution:
Make sure that use of this program agrees with your organization's
acceptable use and security policies.

plugins.name: LimeWire Installed
plugins.synopsis:
A peer-to-peer file sharing application is installed on the remote
Windows host.
plugins.description:
LimeWire, peer-to-peer file sharing software, is installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if it does not comply with your corporate
security policy.

plugins.name: Trillian Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is an instant messaging application installed on the remote
Windows host.
plugins.description:
Trillian is installed on the remote Windows host. Trillian is an
instant messaging client for Windows.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if its use does not match your corporate security
policy.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Messenger Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host contains an instant messaging client.
plugins.description:
Windows Messenger, an instant messaging client, is installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.solution:
Ensure that use of this softare agrees with your organization's
acceptable use and security policies.

plugins.name: WinMX Detection
XoloX Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is running P2P software.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using XoloX, a P2P program which might not be
suitable for a business environment.
plugins.solution:
Make sure that use of this software agrees with your organization's
security policy.

plugins.name: Yahoo! Messenger Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows host contains an instant-messaging application.
plugins.description:
Yahoo! Messenger, an instant-messaging application, is installed on
the Windows host.
plugins.solution:
Make sure the use of this program is in accordance with your corporate
security policy.

plugins.name: MS03-009: Microsoft ISA Server DNS - Denial Of Service (331065)
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to launch a denial of service attack against the
remote DNS application filter.
plugins.description:
A vulnerability in Microsoft ISA Server 2000 allows an attacker to
cause a denial of service in DNS services by sending a specially
crafted DNS request packet.

Note that, to be vulnerable, the ISA Server must be manually
configured to publish an internal DNS server, which it does not do by
default.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for ISA Server 2000.

plugins.name: Samba TNG < 0.3.1 Multiple Remote Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code may be run on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is vulnerable 
to multiple flaws that could let an attacker gain a root shell on this 
host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba TNG 0.3.1

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Administrator Default Password Detection (W32/Deloder Worm Susceptibility)
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is vulnerable to the W32/Deloder worm.
plugins.description:
W32/Deloder is a worm that tries to connect to a remote share by using
a list of built-in administrator passwords. 

Nessus was able to connect to this host with one of these credentials. 
The worm W32/Deloder may use it to break into the remote host and upload
infected data in the remote shares.
plugins.solution: Change your administrator password to a strong one.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Winlogon Cached Password Weakness
plugins.synopsis: User credentials are stored in memory.
plugins.description:
The registry key 'HKLM\Software\Microsoft\WindowsNT\CurrentVersion\
Winlogon\CachedLogonsCount' is not 0. Using a value greater than 0 for
the CachedLogonsCount key indicates that the remote Windows host
locally caches the passwords of the users when they login, in order to
continue to allow the users to login in the case of the failure of the
primary domain controller (PDC).

Cached logon credentials could be accessed by an attacker and subjected  
to brute force attacks.
plugins.solution: Consult Microsoft documentation and best practices.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Dial-In Enabled
plugins.synopsis: Dial-in access is enabled.
plugins.description:
Dial-in access is enabled on the remote Windows host. Provided a modem
is installed, attackers may be able to dial into this host, bypassing
firewall restrictions, and gaining access to the internal network.
plugins.solution:
Edit the registry and set the value of the registry key
'HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows\Policies\Network
odialin' to 1.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Last Logged User Name Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to know last logged user name.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows
NT\WinLogon\DontDisplayLastUserName is not set to 1.

It means that users who attempt to log in locally will see the name of
the last user who logged in successfully in this computer on the
screen.
plugins.solution: Use regedt32 and set the value of this key to 1

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : Classic Logon Screen
plugins.synopsis: User lists is displayed locally.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKLM\Software\Microsoft\Windows
NT\CurrentVersion\WinLogon\LogonType is set to 1.

It means that users who attempt to log in locally will see get the
'new' WindowsXP logon screen which displays the list of users of the
remote host.
plugins.solution: Use regedt32 and set the value of this key to 0

plugins.name: MS03-010: Flaw in RPC Endpoint Mapper Could Allow Denial of Service Attacks (331953)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to disable the remote RPC service.
plugins.description:
A flaw exists in the RPC endpoint mapper that can be used by an
attacker to disable it remotely.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for the Windows 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: RealPlayer PNG Deflate Algorithm Heap Corruption Arbitrary Code Execution
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application is affected by a heap corruption
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
According to its build number, the installed version of RealPlayer /
RealOne Player / RealPlayer Enterprise for Windows has a flaw in the
remote version that may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on
the remote host, with the privileges of the user running RealPlayer. 

To do so, an attacker would need to send a corrupted PNG file to a
remote user and have him open it using RealPlayer.
plugins.solution: Upgrade according to the vendor advisories referenced above.

plugins.name: QuickTime < 6.1 URL Handling Overflow (Windows)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code may be run on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of the QuickTime player is vulnerable to
a buffer overflow.

To exploit it, an attacker would need a user of this host to
visit a rogue webpage with a malformed link in it. He could
then be able to execute arbitrary code with the rights of the user
visiting the page.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to QuickTime Player version 6.1 or later.

plugins.name: Samba < 2.2.8a / 3.0.0 Multiple Remote Overflows
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code may be run on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server is vulnerable to a buffer overflow when it
calls the function trans2open(). An attacker may exploit this flaw to
gain a root shell on this host.

In addition, it is reported that this version of Samba is vulnerable
to additional overflows, although Nessus has not checked for them.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.2.8a or 3.0.0.

plugins.name: MS03-011: Flaw in Microsoft VM (816093)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the VM.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a Microsoft VM machine that has a bug in
its bytecode verifier that could allow a remote attacker to execute
arbitrary code on this host with the privileges of the user running
the VM.

To exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need to send a
malformed applet to a user on this host and have him execute it.  The
malicious applet would then be able to execute code outside the
sandbox of the VM.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft VM is no longer supported, and previous updates are no
longer available.  Upgrade to an actively supported product.

plugins.name: Winamp < 3.0b Multiple File Handling DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains an application affected by multiple
vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp3, a popular media player which handles
many files format (mp3, wavs and more...)

This version suffers from multiple buffer overflow and denial of
service issues that can be triggered by specially crafted b4s files.
To perform an attack, the attack would have to send a malformed
playlist (.b4s) to the user of this host who would then have to load
it by double clicking on it.

Note that since .b4s are XML-based files, most antivirus programs will
let them in.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp 3.0b or later.

plugins.name: MS03-012: Microsoft ISA Server Winsock Proxy DoS (331066)
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to launch a denial of service attack against the
remote proxy server.
plugins.description:
A vulnerability in Microsoft Proxy Server 2.0 and ISA Server 2000
allows an attacker to cause a denial of service of the remote Winsock
proxy service by sending a specially crafted packet that would cause
100% CPU utilization on the remote host and make it unresponsive.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for ISA Server 2000.

plugins.name: MS03-013: Buffer Overrun in Windows Kernel Message Handling could Lead to Elevated Privileges (811493)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows has a flaw in the way the kernel passes
error messages to a debugger.  An attacker could exploit it to gain
elevated privileges on this host.

To successfully exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need a
local account on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: ScriptLogic $LOGS Share Remote Information Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: Sensitive data may be accessed on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote host has an accessible LOGS$ share.

ScriptLogic creates this share to store the logs, but does not
properly set the permissions on it. As a result, anyone can use it to
read or modify, or possibly execute code.
plugins.solution:
Limit access to this share to the backup account and domain
administrator.

plugins.name: ScriptLogic Multiple Service Remote Privilege Escalation
ICQ < 2003b Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a program that is affected by
multiple flaws.
plugins.description:
There are multiple flaws in versions of ICQ before 2003b, including
some that may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to ICQ 2003b or later.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.11 Filename Extension Handling Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by a buffer
overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host has a buffer
overflow condition in the code which handles the file extensions of
the remote web pages. 

To exploit them, an attacker would need to set up a rogue website,
then lure a user of this host visit it using Opera.  He would then be
able to execute arbitrary code on this host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 7.11 or newer.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows shlwapi.dll Malformed HTML Tag Handling Null Pointer DoS
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote web client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the shlwapi.dll which crashes
when processing a malformed HTML form.

An attacker may use this flaw to prevent the users of this host from
working properly.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a malformed HTML
file to the remote user, either by email or by making the user visit a
rogue website.
plugins.solution: None

plugins.name: MS03-017: Windows Media Player Skin Download Overflow (817787)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the media
player.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using a version of Windows Media player that is
vulnerable to a directory traversal attack through its handling of
'skins'.

An attacker could exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this
host with the privileges of the user running Windows Media Player.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to craft a specially
malformed skin and send it to a user of this host, either directly by
email or by sending a URL pointing to it.

Affected Software :

 - Microsoft Windows Media Player 7.1
 - Microsoft Windows Media Player for Windows XP (Version 8.0)
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows Media Player.

plugins.name: DBTools DBManager catalog.mdb Plaintext Local Credential Disclosure
plugins.synopsis:
The database manager on the remote host has an information disclosure
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running DBManager from DBTool - a GUI to manage
MySQL and PostgreSQL databases.

This program stores the passwords and IP addresses of the managed
databases in an unencrypted file. A local attacker could use the data
in this file to log into the managed databases and execute arbitrary
SQL queries.
plugins.solution: There is no solution at this time.

plugins.name: Dr.Web File Name Handling Overflow
plugins.synopsis: The antivirus scanner is vulnerable to a denial of service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Dr.Web - an antivirus program.

There is a flaw in the remote version of Dr.Web which may make it
crash when scanning files whose name is excessively long.

An attacker may use this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this host.
To exploit it, an attacker would need to send a file to the remote
host and have it scanned by this software.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 4.29b or newer

plugins.name: Drag And Zip File Name Handling Overflow
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code may be run on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Drag And Zip - a file compression utility.

There is a flaw in this program which may allow a remote attacker to
execute arbitrary code on this host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to craft a special Zip
file and send it to a user on this host. Then, the user would need to
open it using Drag And Zip.
plugins.solution: None

plugins.name: Sun Java Media Framework (JMF) Arbitrary Code Execution
plugins.synopsis:
A framework installed on the remote Windows host has a code execution
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Sun Microsystems's Java Media Framework
(JMF).

There is a bug in the version installed that may allow an untrusted
applet to crash the Java Virtual Machine it is being run on, or even
to gain unauthorized privileges.

An attacker could exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this
host. To exploit this flaw, the attacker would need to trick a user
into running a malicious Java applet.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to JMF 2.1.1e or later.

plugins.name: CesarFTP settings.ini Authentication Credential Plaintext Disclosure
plugins.synopsis: The remote FTP server is storing unencrypted passwords on disk.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running CesarFTP.

Due to a design flaw in the program, the plaintext usernames and
passwords of FTP users are stored in the file 'settings.ini'. Any user
with an account on this host may read this file and use the password
to connect to this FTP server.
plugins.solution: There is no known solution at this time.

plugins.name: BlackMoon FTP Server blackmoon.mdb Plaintext Password Disclosure
plugins.synopsis:
The remote FTP server is affected by a password disclosure
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
BlackMoon FTP server is installed on the remote host. FTP usernames
and passwords are stored on the server in plaintext in a filed called
'blackmoon.mdb.' Any user with an account on this host may read the
credentials stored in this file, and use them to connect to this FTP
server.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to the latest version of BlackMoon FTP.

plugins.name: MS03-018: Cumulative Patch for Internet Information Services (11114)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote web server.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of IIS that contains various flaws
that could allow remote attackers to disable this service remotely and
local attackers (or remote attackers with the ability to upload
arbitrary files on this server) to gain SYSTEM level access on this
host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for IIS 4.0, 5.0 and 5.1.

plugins.name: PFTP Cleartext Local Password Disclosure
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that stores user names and
passwords in cleartext.
plugins.description:
The remote web server is running PFTP.

This software stores the list of user names and passwords in clear
text in \Program Files\PFTP\PFTPUSERS3.USR.

An attacker with a full access to this host may use this flaw to gain
access to other FTP servers used by the same users.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: IRCXPro Plaintext Passwords Local Disclosure
plugins.synopsis:
The remote web server is affected by an information disclosure
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote web server is running IRCXPro.
