This software stores the list of user names and passwords in plaintext 
in \Program Files\IRCXPro\Settings.ini.

An attacker with a full access to this host may use this flaw to gain
the list of passwords of your users.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to IRCXPro 1.1 or newer

plugins.name: LeapFTP < 2.7.4.x PASV Reply Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host is running an FTP client that is affected by a buffer
overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running LeapFTP - an FTP client.

There is a flaw in the remote version of this software that could
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To exploit it, an attacker would need to set up a rogue FTP server and
have a user on this host connect to it.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to version 2.7.4.x or newer as this reportedly fixes the
issue.

plugins.name: SmartFTP Multiple Command Response Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to execute arbitrary code on the remote host through a
remote FTP client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running SmartFTP - an FTP client.

There is a flaw in the remote version of this software that could allow an 
attacker to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To exploit it, an attacker would need to set up a rogue FTP server and have 
a user on this host connect to it.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 1.0.976.x or newer.

plugins.name: FlashFXP < 2.1b923 Multiple Remote Overflows
plugins.synopsis:
An FTP client with multiple stack buffer overflow vulnerabilities is
installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
FlashFXP, an FTP client, is installed on the remote host.  This
version is vulnerable to a stack-based buffer overflow attack when
receiving a long response to the PASV command, or when processing a
long host name.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to FlashFXP 2.1 build 923 or later.

plugins.name: FTP Voyager LIST Command File List Handling Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host is running an FTP client that is affected by a remote
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running FTP Voyager - an FTP client.

The version installed is earlier than 10.0.0.1. Such versions are
reportedly affected by a buffer overflow vulnerability. An attacker
could exploit this flaw in order to execute arbitrary code on this
host.

To exploit it, an attacker would need to set up a rogue FTP server and
have a user on this host connect to it.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version FTP Voyager 10.0.0.1 or newer.

plugins.name: CuteFTP < 5.0.2.0 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote FTP client is affected by various issues.
plugins.description:
CuteFTP, an FTP client, is installed on the remote Windows host.

The version of CuteFTP on the remote host reportedly is affected by a
buffer overflow that may be exploited by an attacker to execute
arbitrary commands, subject to the privileges of the current user. To
exploit this issue, an attacker would need to set up a rogue FTP
server and lure a user of this host to browse it using CuteFTP.

In addition, the client is also affected by a flaw in which a local
user can crash the client by copying a long URL into the clipboard.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to CuteFTP 5.0.2.0 or later.

plugins.name: MS03-021: Windows Media Player Library Access (819639)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the media
player.
plugins.description:
An ActiveX control included with Windows Media Player 9 Series may
allow a rogue website to gain information about the remote host.

An attacker could exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this
host with the privileges of the user running Windows Media Player.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to set up a rogue website
and lure a user of this host into visiting it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for WMP 6.4, 7.1 and XP.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Share Hosting Possibly Copyrighted Material
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host may contain material (movies/audio) infringing
copyright.
plugins.description:
This plugin displays a list of media files (such as .mp3, .ogg, .mpg,
.avi) which have been found on the remote SMB shares. 

Some of these files may contain copyrighted materials, such as
commercial movies or music files, that are being shared without the
owner's permission. 

If any of these files actually contain copyrighted material, and if they
are freely swapped around, your organization might be held liable for
copyright infringement by associations such as the RIAA or the MPAA.
plugins.solution: Delete the files infringing copyright.

plugins.name: MS03-024: SMB Request Handler Buffer Overflow (817606)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is affected by a vulnerability in its SMB stack that
could allow an authenticated attacker to corrupt the memory of this
host.  This may result in execution of arbitrary code on this host, or
an attacker may disable this host remotely.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP.

plugins.name: MS03-025: Flaw in Windows Message Handling through Utility Manager Could Enable Privilege Elevation (822679)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote host runs a version of Windows that has a flaw in the way
the utility manager handles Windows messages.  As a result, it is
possible for a local user to gain additional privileges on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS03-026 / MS03-039: Buffer Overrun In RPCSS Service Could Allow Code Execution (823980 / 824146)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows affected by several
vulnerabilities in its RPC interface and RPCSS Service, that could allow
an attacker to execute arbitrary code and gain SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS03-027: Buffer overrun in Windows Shell (821557)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Explorer.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that has a flaw in its
shell.  An attacker could exploit it by creating a malicious Desktop.ini
file, putting it on a shared folder and waiting for someone to browse
it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP.

plugins.name: MS03-029: Flaw in Windows Function may allow DoS (823803)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows NT 4.0 that has a flaw
in one of its functions that could allow a user to cause a denial of
service on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT.

plugins.name: MS03-030: DirectX MIDI Overflow (819696)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through DirectX.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows with a version of
DirectX that is vulnerable to a buffer overflow attack involving the
module that handles MIDI files.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker needs to craft a rogue MIDI file and
send it to a user of this computer.  When the user attempts to read the
file, it will trigger the buffer overflow condition and the attacker may
gain a shell on this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for DirectX.

plugins.name: MS03-031: Cumulative Patch for MS SQL Server (815495)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the SQL
service.
plugins.description:
The remote Microsoft SQL server is vulnerable to several flaws :

  - Named pipe hijacking
  - Named Pipe Denial of Service
  - SQL server buffer overrun

These flaws could allow a user to gain elevated privileges on this
host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for MSSQL 7 and 2000.

plugins.name: MS03-026: Microsoft RPC Interface Buffer Overrun (823980) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the function
RemoteActivation() in its RPC interface that could allow an attacker to
execute arbitrary code on the remote host with the SYSTEM privileges.

A series of worms (Blaster) are known to exploit this vulnerability in the
wild.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP, and 2003.

plugins.name: MS Blaster Worm (msblast.exe) Infection Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is infected by a virus.
plugins.description:
The remote host seems to be infected by the MS Blaster worm, or the
Nachi worm, which may make this host attack random hosts on the
internet.
plugins.solution: Refer to the vendor advisory.

plugins.name: MS03-034: Flaw in NetBIOS Could Lead to Information Disclosure (824105) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote service is affected by an information disclosure
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the NetBT name service that
suffers from a memory disclosure problem.

An attacker may send a special packet to the remote NetBT name
service, and the reply will contain random arbitrary data from the
remote host memory. This arbitrary data may be a fragment from the web
page the remote user is viewing, or something more serious like a
password.

An attacker may use this flaw to continuously 'poll' the content of
the memory of the remote host and might be able to obtain sensitive
information.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP, and 2003.

plugins.name: MS03-035: Word Macros may run automatically (827653)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through VBA.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Word that contains a
flaw in its handling of macro command execution.  An attacker could use
this to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue Word file to a user
of this computer and have him open it.  Then the macros contained in the
Word file would bypass the security model of Word and be executed.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office.

plugins.name: MS03-037: Visual Basic for Application Overflow (822715)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through VBA.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Visual Basic for
Applications that is vulnerable to a buffer overflow when handling
malformed documents.

An attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this
host by sending a malformed file to a user of the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office.

plugins.name: MS03-039: Microsoft RPC Interface Buffer Overrun (824146) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that has a flaw in its
RPC interface, which may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code
and gain SYSTEM privileges.

An attacker or a worm could use it to gain the control of this host.

Note that this is NOT the same bug as the one described in MS03-026,
which fixes the flaw exploited by the 'MSBlast' (or LoveSan) worm.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP, and 2003.

plugins.name: MS03-039 Exploitation Backdoor Account Detection
Shareaza Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is a peer-to-peer file sharing application installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
Shareaza is installed on the remote host. Shareaza is an open source
peer-to-peer file sharing application for Windows and, as such, may
not be suitable for use in a business environment.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : NT MTS Package Administration Registry Key Permission Weakness
plugins.synopsis: A local user can gain additional privileges.
plugins.description:
The registry key HKLM\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Transaction Server\Packages
can be modified by users not in the admin group.

Write access to this key allows an unprivileged user to gain
additional privileges.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows SMB Registry : SNMP Registry Key Permission Weakness Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis: Local users can gain additional privileges.
plugins.description:
The registry key
HKLM\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Services\SNMP\Parameters can be modified
by users who are not in the admin group.

Write access to this key allows an unprivileged user to gain
additional privileges.
plugins.solution:
Use regedt32 and set the permissions of this key to :

- admin group  : Full Control
    - system	   : Full Control
    - everyone	   : Read

plugins.name: Microsoft SQL Server < 7 Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis:
The remote SQL Server is affected by a local privilege escalation
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
Based on its version number, the remote host may be vulnerable to a
local exploit wherein an authenticated user can obtain and crack SQL
usernames and passwords from the registry. 

An attacker may use this flaw to elevate their privileges on the local
database. 

*** This alert might be a false positive, as Nessus did not actually
*** check for this flaw but relied solely on the presence of Microsoft
*** SQL 7 to issue this alert.
plugins.solution:
Ensure that the configuration has enabled Always prompting for login
name and password.

plugins.name: MS03-023: Buffer Overrun In HTML Converter Could Allow Code Execution (823559)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the HTML Converter module that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host by
constructing a malicious web page and enticing a victim to visit this
web page.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: AOL Instant Messenger (AIM) Software Detection (credentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is running an instant messaging client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running AOL Instant Messenger (AIM). AIM is a
commonly used chat client.
plugins.solution:
Make sure use of this software agress with your organization's
security and acceptable use policies.

plugins.name: MS03-045: Buffer Overrun in the ListBox and in the ComboBox (824141)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate privileges.
plugins.description:
A vulnerability exists because the ListBox control and the ComboBox
control both call a function, located in the User32.dll file, that
contains a buffer overrun.  A local, interactive attacker could run a
program that sends a specially crafted Windows message to any
application that has implemented the ListBox control or the ComboBox
control, causing the application to take any action specified.

An attacker must have valid login credentials to exploit the
vulnerability.  It can not be exploited remotely.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS03-041: Vulnerability in Authenticode Verification Could Allow Remote Code Execution (823182)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Authenticode Verification
module that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host by constructing a malicious web page and entice a victim to
visit this web page.

An attacker may also be able to exploit the vulnerability by sending a
malicious HTML email.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS03-042: Buffer Overflow in Windows Troubleshooter ActiveX Control (826232)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Troubleshooter ActiveX
control module that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on
the remote host by constructing a malicious web page and entice a victim
to visit this web page.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS03-043: Buffer Overrun in Messenger Service (828035)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a Heap Overflow in the Messenger
service that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with the SYSTEM privileges.

A series of worms (Gaobot, Agobot, ...) are known to exploit this
vulnerability in the wild.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.21 HREF Escaped Character Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The installed version of Opera on the remote host is 
vulnerable to a buffer overflow in the code that parses 
HREF tags in the server. 

To exploit them, an attacker would need to set up a rogue
website, then lure a user of this host to visit the site using Opera.
The attacker would then be able to execute arbitrary code on this 
host.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.21 or newer.

plugins.name: MS03-050: Word and/or Excel may allow arbitrary code to run (831527)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Office.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Word and/or Microsoft
Excel that are subject to a flaw that could allow arbitrary code to be
run.

An attacker could use this to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue Word or Excel file
to the owner of this computer and have him open it.  Then the macros
contained in the Word file would bypass the security model of Word, and
would be executed.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 97, 2000 and
2002.

plugins.name: MS03-049: Buffer Overflow in the Workstation Service (828749)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the function
NetpValidateName() in the WorkStation service that could allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host with the SYSTEM
privileges.

A series of worms (Welchia, Spybot, ...) are known to exploit this
vulnerability in the wild.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.22 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains a web browser which is affected by multiple
issues.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Opera, an alternative web browser. 

The version of Opera installed on the remote host is affected by
several issues.  One may allow an attacker to drop arbitrary files
with arbitrary names on this host; another may allow an attacker to
traverse directories on the affected host. 

To exploit these flaws, an attacker would need to set up a rogue
website and lure a user of this host visit it using Opera.  He might
then be able to execute arbitrary code on this host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Opera version 7.22 or later.

plugins.name: MS03-044: Buffer Overrun in Windows Help (825119)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the Help
service.
plugins.description:
A security vulnerability exists in the Windows Help Service that could
allow arbitrary code execution on an affected system.  An attacker who
successfully exploited this vulnerability could run code with Local
System privileges on this host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: Flash Player < 7.0.19.0 Predictable Data Location Weakness
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains an application that is affected by a remote
file disclosure vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Flash Player older than
7.0.19.0. 

Such versions can be abused in conjunction with several flaws in the
web browser to read local files on an affected system. 

To exploit this issue, an attacker would need to lure a user of the
software into visiting a rogue website containing a malicious Flash
applet.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 7.0.19.0 or newer.

plugins.name: MS04-002: Exchange Privilege Escalation (832759)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to access other users mailboxes.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running an unpatched version of Microsoft Exchange
that could allow an attacker with a valid Exchange account to access
another user's mailbox using Outlook for Web Access
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Exchange 2003.

plugins.name: MS04-003: MDAC Buffer Overflow (832483)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through MDAC server.
plugins.description:
The remote Microsoft Data Access Component (MDAC) server is vulnerable
to a flaw that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on this
host, provided he can simulate responses from a SQL server.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to wait for a host running
a vulnerable MDAC implementation to send a broadcast query.  He would
then need to send a malicious packet pretending to come from a SQL
server.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-001: Vulnerability in Microsoft ISA Server 2000 H.323 Filter(816458)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
A buffer overflow vulnerability in the H.323 filter of the Microsoft
ISA Server 2000 allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.  An attacker can exploit this vulnerability by sending a
specially crafted packet to the remote ISA Server.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for ISA Server Gold and SP1.

plugins.name: AUREATE Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote as an advertising program installed.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using the AUREATE program. You should ensure that:
- the user intended to install AUREATE (it is sometimes silently
installed) - the use of AUREATE matches your corporate mandates and
security policies.
plugins.solution:
Uninstall this software if it does not match your corporate security
policy.

plugins.name: BONZI BUDDY Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has spyware installed on it.
plugins.description:

- The user intended to install BONZI BUDDY (it is sometimes
    silently
    installed)
    - The use of BONZI BUDDY matches your corporate mandates

    policies.

Uninstall this software. To remove this sort of software, you may wish
to check out Ad-Aware or Spybot.

plugins.name: Brilliant Digital Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: Spyware is installed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
Brilliant Digital, a media player that tracks browsing habits, is
installed on the remote host. This program has been reported to cause
excessive CPU and memory consumption and occasional crashes.
plugins.solution:
Ensure Brilliant Digital was intended to be installed (it is sometimes
silently installed), and that the use of this software is in
accordance with your corporate mandates and security policies. If not,
then remove the software.

plugins.name: DSSAGENT Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: A potentially unwanted program is installed on this host.

To remove this sort of software, you may wish to check out ad-aware or
spybot.

To remove this sort of software, you may wish to check out ad-aware or

plugins.solution: Uninstall this software.

plugins.name: LOP.COM Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has a suspicious application installed.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using the LOP.COM program. You should ensure that:
- the user intended to install LOP.COM (it is sometimes silently
installed) - the use of LOP.COM matches your corporate mandates and

To remove this sort of software, install software such as Ad-Aware or
Spybot.
plugins.solution: Uninstall this software.

plugins.name: TIMESINK Spyware Detection

plugins.name: WEBHANCER Detection
Web3000 Detection
BargainBuddy Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has adware installed on it.
plugins.description:
BargainBuddy is installed on the remote host. This is an adware
program that monitors web searches and displays advertisements based
on the search terms.
plugins.solution: Remove this software using a spyware or adware removal product.

plugins.name: BetterInternet Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: An adware program is installed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using BetterInternet. This program monitors web
traffic, displaying pop-up/pop-under advertisements based on the
content.
plugins.solution: Remove this program using an adware or spyware removal product.

plugins.name: CYDOOR Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: An adware program is installed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
Cydoor Desktop Media, an adware program, is installed on the remote
host. This program displays pop-up/pop-under advertisements and
changes web browser settings (e.g., homepage) without the user's
permission.
plugins.solution: Remove this program using an adware or spyware removal product.

plugins.name: DOWNLOADWARE Software Detection
plugins.synopsis: A potentially unwanted program is installed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using the DOWNLOADWARE program. You should ensure
that: - the user intended to install DOWNLOADWARE (it is sometimes
silently installed) - the use of DOWNLOADWARE matches your corporate
mandates and security policies.

To remove this sort of software, you may wish to check out ad-aware or
spybot.
plugins.solution: Uninstall this software

plugins.name: Free Community Detection
plugins.synopsis: An adware program is installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
Free Community is installed on the remote host. This is an adware
program that monitors web traffic, and replaces banner advertisements
with advertisements of its choosing.
plugins.solution: Remove this program using a spyware or adware removal product.

plugins.name: IPINSIGHT Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has an Internet Explorer Addon installed.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using the IPINSIGHT program. You should ensure that
the user intended to install IPINSIGHT as it is sometimes silently
installed.
plugins.solution:
Check that the use of this software matches your corporate security
policies.

plugins.name: MapQuest Toolbar Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has a toolbar application installed.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using the MapQuest Toolbar program. You should

plugins.name: NCASE Software Detection

plugins.name: WILDTANGENT detection
Microsoft Windows SMB : WindowsUpdate Disabled
plugins.synopsis: Remote system is not configured for automatic updates.
plugins.description:
The remote host does not have Windows Update enabled.

Enabling WindowsUpdate will ensure that the remote Windows host has
all the latest Microsoft Patches installed.
plugins.solution: Enable Windows Update on this host

plugins.name: RealPlayer File Handler Arbitrary Code Execution
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows application is affected by several remote flaws.
plugins.description:
According to its build number, the installed version of RealPlayer /
RealOne Player / RealPlayer Enterprise has a flaw that may allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host, with the
privileges of the user running RealPlayer, using specially crafted RP,
RT, RAM, RPM or SMIL files. 

In addition, it may allow an attacker to download and execute
arbitrary code on the affected system using specially crafted RMP
files.
plugins.solution: Upgrade according to the vendor advisories referenced above.

plugins.name: MS04-006: WINS Server Remote Overflow (830352)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows Internet Naming Service (WINS) is vulnerable to a
flaw that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on this
host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially crafted
packet with improperly advertised lengths.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-007: ASN.1 parsing vulnerability (828028)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows host has a ASN.1 library that is vulnerable to a
flaw that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on this
host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially crafted
ASN.1 encoded packet (either an IPsec session negotiation, or an HTTPS
request) with improperly advertised lengths.

A public code is available to exploit this flaw.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-007: ASN.1 Vulnerability Could Allow Code Execution (828028) (uncredentialed check) (NTLM)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows host has an ASN.1 library that could allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially
crafted ASN.1 encoded packet with improperly advertised lengths.

This particular check sent a malformed NTLM packet and determined that
the remote host is not patched.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP, and 2003.

plugins.name: Trillian DirectIM Packet Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains an instant messaging client that is
vulnerable to a buffer overflow attack.
plugins.description:
An integer buffer overflow exists in the AOL Instant Messenger (AIM)
component of the version of Trillian instant messaging client
installed on the remote host. By sending a DirectIM packet with a size
above 8k bytes, a remote attacker can potentially execute code on the
affected host subject to the user's privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Trillian 0.74 patch G or higher.

plugins.name: MS04-008: Windows Media Services Remote Denial of Service (832359)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote Media Service.
plugins.description:
The remote host appears to be vulnerable to a remote denial of service
attack (DoS) against the Media Services component. An attacker, in
exploiting this bug, would render the Media Services component as
unresponsive.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS04-010: MSN Messenger Information Disclosure (838512)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to read files on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running MSN Messenger.

The remote host appears to be vulnerable to a remote attack wherein an
attacker can read any local file that the victim has 'read' access to.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Messenger 6.0 and 6.1.

plugins.name: MS04-009: Vulnerability in Outlook could allow code execution (828040)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the email
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of outlook that could allow
Internet Explorer to execute script code in the Local Machine zone and
therefore let an attacker execute arbitrary programs on this host.

To exploit this bug, an attacker would need to send an special HTML
message to a user of this host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2002 and XP.

plugins.name: Norton AntiVirus Detection and Status (deprecated)
plugins.synopsis: This plugin has been deprecated.
plugins.description:
This plugin has been deprecated. It has been replaced by Symantec
Antivirus Software Detection and Status, ID 21725.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: McAfee Antivirus Detection and Status
plugins.synopsis:
An antivirus application is installed on the remote host, but it is
not working properly.
plugins.description:
McAfee VirusScan, an antivirus application, is installed on the remote
host. However, there is a problem with the installation; either its
services are not running or its virus definitions are
out of date.
plugins.solution:
Make sure that updates are working and the associated services are
running.

plugins.name: WS_FTP Pro Client ASCII Mode Directory Listing Handling Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an FTP client that is prone to a buffer
overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The version of WS_FTP Pro, an FTP client, installed on the remote host
is earlier than 9.0. Such versions are reportedly affected by a remote
overflow triggered by an overly long string of ASCII mode directory
data from a malicious server.

If an attacker can trick a user on this system to connect to a
malicious FTP server using the affected application, this issue could
be leveraged to execute arbitrary code subject to the user's
privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to WS_FTP Pro 9.0, as that reportedly addresses the issue.

plugins.name: PhatBOT Backdoor Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host has a trojan installed.
plugins.description:
The remote systems appears to have PhatBOT installed. This program
allows the machine to be controlled via a P2P network. PhatBOT is
extremely sophisticated and allows the remote attacker to use the
victim machine to perform various actions.
plugins.solution: Remove PhatBOT immediately.

plugins.name: ISS BlackICE Multiple Remote Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The firewall running on the remote host has multiple buffer overflow
vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
ISS BlackICE is a personal Firewall/IDS for windows Desktops. Several
remote holes have been found in the product. An attacker, exploiting
these flaws, would be able to either crash the remote firewall/IDS
service or execute code on the target machine.

According to the remote version number, the remote host is vulnerable
to at least one remote overflow.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to the latest version of BlackICE.

plugins.name: MS04-011: Microsoft Hotfix (credentialed check) (835732)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing a critical Microsoft Windows Security Update
(835732).

This update fixes various flaws that could allow an attacker to execute
arbitrary code on the remote host.

A series of worms (Sasser) are known to exploit this vulnerability in
the wild.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-012: Microsoft Hotfix (credentialed check) (828741)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host has multiple bugs in its RPC/DCOM implementation
(828741).

An attacker could exploit one of these flaws to execute arbitrary code
on the remote system.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-014: Microsoft Hotfix (credentialed check) (837001)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through database
engine.
plugins.description:
The remote host has a bug in its Microsoft Jet Database Engine
(837001).

An attacker could exploit one of these flaws to execute arbitrary code
on the remote system.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need the ability to craft a
specially malformed database query and have this engine execute it.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-013: Cumulative Update for Outlook Express (837009)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host has a version of Outlook Express that has a bug in its
MHTML URL processor that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary
code on this host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a malformed email
to a user of this host using Outlook, or would need to lure him into
visiting a rogue website.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-011: Security Update for Microsoft Windows (835732) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
LSASS service.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the function
'DsRolerUpgradeDownlevelServer' of the Local Security Authority Server
Service (LSASS) that allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code on
the remote host with SYSTEM privileges.

A series of worms (Sasser) are known to exploit this vulnerability in
the wild.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: TCP/IP Sequence Prediction Blind Reset Spoofing DoS
plugins.synopsis: It was possible to send spoofed RST packets to the remote system.
plugins.description:
The remote host is affected by a sequence number approximation
vulnerability that allows an attacker to send spoofed RST packets to
the remote host and close established connections. This may cause
problems for some dedicated services (BGP, a VPN over TCP, etc).
plugins.solution: Contact the vendor for a patch or mitigation advice.

plugins.name: Sophos Anti-Virus Detection and Status
plugins.synopsis:
An antivirus application is installed on the remote host, but it is
not working properly.
plugins.description:
Sophos Anti-Virus, a commercial antivirus software package for
Windows, is installed on the remote host. However, there is a problem
with the installation; either its services are not running or its
engine and/or virus definitions are out of date.
plugins.solution:
Make sure that updates are working and the associated services are
running.

plugins.name: QuickTime < 6.5.1 .mov File sample-to-chunk Table Data Handling Overflow (Windows)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has a media player installed that is affected
by a remote code execution vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using QuickTime, a popular media player/Plug-in
that handles many Media files.

This version has a Heap overflow that could allow an attacker
to execute arbitrary code on this host, with the rights of the user
running QuickTime.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to QuickTime version 6.5.1 or higher.

plugins.name: MS04-015: Microsoft Help Center Remote Code Execution (840374)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains bugs in the Microsoft Help and Support Center
in the way it handles HCP URL validation.  (840374)

An attacker could use this bug to execute arbitrary commands on the
remote host.  To exploit this bug, an attacker would need to lure a user
of the remote host into visiting a rogue website or to click on a link
received in an email.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2003 and XP.

plugins.name: Firebird DB Remote Database Name Overflow
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Firebird database.  The remote version of
this service is vulnerable to a remote stack-based overflow. 

An attacker, exploiting this hole, would be given full access to the
target machine.  Versions of Firebird database less than 1.5.0 are
reportedly vulnerable to this overflow.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 1.5.0 or higher.

plugins.name: MS04-016: Vulnerability in DirectPlay Could Allow Denial of Service (839643)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote DirectPlay service.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of DirectPlay that is vulnerable to
a denial of service attack.  DirectPlay is a component of DirectX and is
frequently used by game developpers to create networked multi-player
games.

An attacker could exploit this flaw by sending a malformed IDirectPlay
packet to a remote application using this service and cause it to
crash.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS KB870669: ADODB.Stream object from Internet Explorer
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains a version of IE which may read and write to
local files.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a vulnerability in IE.  The ADODB.Stream
object can be used by a malicious web page to read and write to local
files. 

An attacker could use this flaw to gain access to the data on the remote
host.  To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to set up a rogue
website and lure a user on the remote host into visiting it.  If the
website contains the proper call to the ADODB object, then it may
execute data on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft produced a workaround for this problem.

plugins.name: MS04-019: Utility Manager Could Allow Code Execution (842526)
plugins.synopsis: Local users can elevate their privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the Utility Manager that could
allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code on the host, thus
escalating his privileges and obtaining the full control of the remote
system.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS04-020: Vulnerability in POSIX could allow code execution (841872)
plugins.synopsis: Local users can elevate their privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the posix subsystem that
contains a flaw that could allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary
code on the host, thus escalating his privileges and obtaining the full
control of the remote system.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT and 2000.

plugins.name: MS04-021: IIS Redirection Vulnerability (credentialed check) (841373)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote web server.
plugins.description:
The remote host has a version of IIS 4.0 that could allow an attacker
to take the control of the remote web server and execute arbitrary
commands on the remote host with the SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for IIS 4.0.

plugins.name: MS04-022: Task Scheduler Vulnerability (841873)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows which contains a flaw
in the task scheduler that could lead to arbitrary execution of commands
on the remote host.

To exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need to lure a user
on the remote host to take certain steps to execute a .job file, or to
visit a rogue website, arbitrary commands could then be used on the
remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: MS04-023: Vulnerability in HTML Help Could Allow Code Execution (840315)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is subject to two vulnerabilities in the HTML Help and
showHelp modules that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code
on the remote host.

To exploit these flaws, an attacker would need to set up a rogue website
containing a malicious showHelp URL, and would need to lure a user on
the remote host to visit it.  Once the user visits the website, a
buffer overflow would allow the attacker to execute arbitrary commands
with the privileges of the victim user.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-024: Buffer overrun in Windows Shell (839645)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute commands on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that has a flaw in its
shell.  An attacker could persuade a user on the remote host to execute
a rogue program by using a CLSID instead of a file type, thus fooling
the user into thinking that he will not execute an application but
simply open a document.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-018: Cumulative Security Update for Outlook Express (823353)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing a cumulative security update for Outlook
Express that fixes a denial of service vulnerability in the Outlook
Express mail client.

To exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need to send a
malformed message to a victim on the remote host.  The message will
crash the version of Outlook, thus preventing the user from reading
email.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Outlook Express.

plugins.name: Samba Mangling Method Hash Overflow
plugins.synopsis: It might be possible to run arbitrary code on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is vulnerable 
to a buffer overflow if the option 'mangling method' is set to 'hash' 
in smb.conf (which is not the case by default).

An attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary commands on the 
remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.2.10 or 3.0.5

plugins.name: Opera < 7.53 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by 
multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host is 
vulnerable to two security issues :

  - A cross domain frame loading vulnerability.
  - An unspecified vulnerability in the way it handles
    certificates.

An attacker may exploit one of these flaws to impersonate 
a web server.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.53 or newer.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Installed Hotfixes
plugins.synopsis:
It was not possible to enumerate installed hotfixes on the remote
Windows host.
plugins.description:
Using the supplied credentials, Nessus was unable to log into the remote
Windows host, enumerate installed hotfixes, or store them in its
knowledge base for other plugins to use.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Opera < 7.54 Multiple Function Address Bar Spoofing
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has application that may allow arbitrary 
code execution on the remote system.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host is 
vulnerable to a flaw wherein a remote attacker can obscure 
the URI, leading the user to believe that he/she is 
accessing a trusted resource. To exploit this issue, an 
attacker would need to set up a rogue website, then 
entice a local user to visit the site.  Successful 
exploitation would enable the attacker to execute arbitrary
code on this host.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.54 or newer.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.50 onUnload Address Bar Spoofing
plugins.synopsis: An installed browser is vulnerable to address bar spoofing.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Opera - an alternative web browser.

This version of Opera is vulnerable to a security weakness 
that may permit malicious web pages to spoof address bar information.

This is reportedly possible through malicious use of the 
JavaScript 'unOnload' event handler when the browser 
is redirected to another page.

This issue could be exploited to spoof the domain of a malicious web page, 
potentially causing the user to trust the spoofed domain.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.50 or later.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.51 favicon.ico Address Bar Spoofing
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains a web browser that is vulnerable to 
address bar spoofing attacks.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera is vulnerable to a security weakness that may
permit malicious web pages to spoof address bar information.  It is
reported that the 'favicon' feature can be used to spoof the domain of
a malicious web page.  An attacker can create an icon that includes
the text of the desired site and is similar to the way Opera displays
information in the address bar.  The attacker can then obfuscate the
real address with spaces. 

This issue can be used to spoof information in the address bar, page
bar and page/window cycler.
plugins.solution: Install to Opera 7.51 or newer.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.23 File Download Encoded Traversal Arbitrary File Deletion
plugins.synopsis: Files could be overwritten on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host contains a file 
corruption vulnerability.  This issue is exposed when a user is 
presented with a file dialog, which will cause the creation of a 
temporary file.  It is possible to specify a relative path to another 
file on the system using directory traversal sequences when the
download dialog is displayed.  If the client user has write
permissions to the attacker-specified file, it will be corrupted. 

This could be exploited to delete sensitive files on the systems.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.23 or newer.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.50 File Download Extension Spoofing
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code might be run on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host contains a flaw that
may allow a malicious user to trick a user into running arbitrary
code. 

The issue is triggered when an malicious website provides a file for
download, but crafts the filename in such a way that the file is
executed, rather than saved. 

It is possible that the flaw may allow arbitrary code execution
resulting in a loss of confidentiality, integrity, and/or
availability.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.50 or later.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.50 JavaScript Engine Array Handling DoS
plugins.synopsis: An installed browser is vulnerable to a denial of service attack.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera on the remote host is vulnerable to an issue when
handling large JavaScript arrays. 

In particular, it is possible to crash the browser when performing
various operations on Array objects with 99999999999999999999999 or
0x23000000 elements. 

The crash is due to a segmentation fault and may be indicative of an
exploitable memory corruption vulnerability, possibly resulting in
arbitrary code execution.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.50 or later.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.20 news URL Handling DoS
plugins.synopsis:
A browser installed on the remote host is vulnerable to a denial of 
service attack.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host reportedly crashes
when processing a 'news:' URL of excessive length, that may result in
a denial of service.  It has been reported that this issue will
trigger a condition that will prevent Opera from functioning until the
program has been reinstalled.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.20 or newer.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.23 Zip File Processing Crafted File Handling Overflow
plugins.synopsis: Arrbitrary code may be run on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera on the remote host is vulnerable to a security
weakness. 

A problem has been identified in the handling of zipped skin files by
Opera.  Because of this, it may be possible for an attacker to gain
unauthorized access to a system using the vulnerable browser.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.23 or newer.

plugins.name: MS04-026: Vulnerability in Exchange Server 5.5 Outlook Web Access XSS (842436)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote web server runs a script vulnerable to cross-site scripting
attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host runs Outlook Web Access.

Outlook Web Access is a service for Microsoft Exchange, that provides
web-based email, calendaring and contact management to end users.

The remote version of Outlook Web Access is vulnerable to a cross-site
scripting attack that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary java
script in the security context of a victim using this service.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially crafted
message to a victim using Outlook Web Access.  When the victim reads the
message, the bug in Outlook Web Access triggers and cause the execution
of the script sent by the attacker.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for OWA for Exchange 5.5.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.54 location Object Crafted URL Arbitrary Local File Access
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains a web browser that is affected by 
multiple flaws.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera on the remote host fails to block write access to
the 'location' object.  This could allow a user to create a specially
crafted URL to overwrite methods within the 'location' object that would
execute arbitrary code in a user's browser within the trust relationship
between the browser and the server, leading to a loss of confidentiality
and integrity.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Opera 7.54 or newer.

plugins.name: ISS BlackICE/PC Protection Unprivileged User Local DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The firewall running on the remote host has a local buffer overflow
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
ISS BlackICE is a personal Firewall/IDS for windows Desktops. Based on
the version number, the remote BlackICE install is vulnerable to a
local attack due to incorrect file permissions.

*** Nessus based the results of this test on the contents of *** the
local BlackICE configuration file.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to the latest version of BlackICE.

plugins.name: RealPlayer Multiple Remote Overflows
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application is affected by several remote
overflows.
plugins.description:
According to its build number, the installed version of RealPlayer on
the remote host is vulnerable to several overflows.  In exploiting
these flaws, an attacker would need to be able to coerce a local user
into visiting a malicious URL or downloading a malicious media file
which, on execution, would execute code with the privileges of the
local user.
plugins.solution: Install the updates as outlined in the vendor advisory.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.24 getElementsByTagName JavaScript Method DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by a denial of
service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host is vulnerable to a
remote denial of service.  An attacker may cause the browser to crash
by crafting a rogue HTML page containing a specific JavaScript
command.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.24 or newer.

plugins.name: Opera < 7.54 Download File Type Dialog Spoofing
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by an
information disclosure vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera on the remote host contains a flaw that allows an
attacker to determine the existence of files and directories on the
remote host. 

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to set up a rogue website
and lure a user of the remote host into visiting it with Opera.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.54 or newer.

plugins.name: Samba smbd FindNextPrintChangeNotify() Request Remote DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote service is vulnerable to a denial of service.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is vulnerable 
to a denial of service.

An attacker may be able to crash the remote samba server by sending a 
FindNextPrintChangeNotify() request without previously issuing a 
FindFirstPrintChangeNoticy() call.

It is reported that Windows XP SP2 generates such requests.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.2.11 or 3.0.6

plugins.name: Opera < 7.54 Empty Embedded Object DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by a denial
of service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host contains a flaw that
allows an attacker to crash this browser remotely. 

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to craft a rogue website
containing an embedded 'CCCC' object with an empty 'src' tag in it and
would need to lure a victim to visit it.
plugins.solution: Install Opera 7.54 or newer.

plugins.name: ZoneAlarm Personal Firewall UDP Source Port 67 Bypass
plugins.synopsis:
This host is running a firewall that fails to filter certain types of
traffic.
plugins.description:
This version of ZoneAlarm contains a flaw that may allow a remote
attacker to bypass the ruleset.  The issue is due to ZoneAlarm not
monitoring and alerting UDP traffic with a source port of 67. 

This allows an attacker to bypass the firewall to reach protected
hosts without setting off warnings on the firewall.
plugins.solution: Upgrade at least to version 2.1.25.

plugins.name: Samba < 3.0.7 Multiple Remote DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote service is vulnerable to a denial of service.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is 
vulnerable to a denial of service.

There is a bug in the remote smbd ASN.1 parsing that could allow an 
attacker to cause a denial of service attack against the remote host 
by sending a specially crafted ASN.1 packet during the authentication 
request that could make the newly-spawned smbd process run into an 
infinite loop. By establishing multiple connections and sending such 
packets, an attacker could consume all the CPU and memory of the 
remote host, thus crashing it remotely.

Another bug could allow an attacker to crash the remote nmbd process 
by sending a malformed NetBIOS packet.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 3.0.7.

plugins.name: MS04-028: Buffer Overrun in JPEG Processing (833987)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that is vulnerable to
a buffer overrun attack when viewing a JPEG file which could allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a malformed JPEG
file to a user on the remote host and wait for him to open it using an
affected Microsoft application.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: ZoneAlarm Pro Configuration File/Directory Permission Weakness DoS
plugins.synopsis: This host is running a firewall with a denial of service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
This host is running a version of ZoneAlarm Pro that contains a flaw which may
allow a local denial of service. To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need
to tamper with the files located in %windir%/Internet Logs. An attacker may
modify them and prevent ZoneAlarm from starting up properly.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to the latest version of this software.

plugins.name: MS04-027: Vulnerability in WordPerfect Converter (884933)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Office.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Office that contains
a flaw in its WordPerfect converter, that could allow an attacker to
execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially crafted
file to a user on the remote host and wait for him to open it using
Microsoft Office.

When opening the malformed file, Microsoft Office will encounter a
buffer overflow that could be exploited to execute arbitrary code.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-028 Exploitation Backdoor Account Detection
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to log into the remote host without a password.
plugins.description:
It was possible to log into the remote host with the login 'X' and a
blank password. 

A widely available exploit, using one of the vulnerabilities described
in the Microsoft Bulletin MS04-028 creates such an account.  This
probably means that the remote host has been compromised by the use of
this exploit.
plugins.solution: Re-install the operating system on this host, as it has likely been compromised.

plugins.name: Samba MS-DOS Path Request Arbitrary File Retrieval
plugins.synopsis: The remote file server allows access to arbitrary files.
plugins.description:
According to its version number, the remote Samba server is affected
by a flaw that allows an attacker to access arbitrary files which
exist outside of the shares's defined path.  An attacker needs a valid
account to exploit this flaw.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 2.2.12 / 3.0.7 or later.

plugins.name: RealPlayer Multiple Remote Vulnerabilities (2004-09-28)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application is affected by multiple remote
vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
According to its build number, the installed version of RealPlayer /
RealOne Player for Windows may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary
code and delete arbitrary files on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade according to the vendor advisory referenced above.

plugins.name: Firefox < 0.10.1 Download Directory Arbitrary File Deletion
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a web browser that is affected by
an arbitrary file deletion vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The installed version of Firefox is earlier than 0.10.1.  Such
versions contain a weakness that could allow a remote attacker
to delete arbitrary files in the user download directory.  To
exploit this, an attacker would need to trick a user into viewing
a malicious web page.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Firefox 0.10.1 or later.

plugins.name: MS04-030: WebDAV XML Message Handler Denial of Service (824151)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote web server.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows and IIS that is
vulnerable to a remote denial of service attack through the WebDAV XML
Message Handler.

An attacker may exploit this flaw to prevent the remote web server from
working properly.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-031: Vulnerability in NetDDE Could Allow Code Execution (841533)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the NetDDE
service.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows is affected by a vulnerability in Network
Dynamic Data Exchange (NetDDE).

To exploit this flaw, NetDDE would have to be running and an attacker
with a specific knowledge of the vulnerability would need to send a
malformed NetDDE message to the remote host to overrun a given buffer.

A public exploit is available to exploit this vulnerability.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-032: Security Update for Microsoft Windows (840987)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing a security update for Microsoft Windows
(840987).  The missing security update fixes issues in the following
areas :

  - Window Management
  - Virtual DOS Machine
  - Graphics Rendering Engine
  - Windows Kernel

A local attacker could exploit any of these vulnerabilities to cause a
local denial of service or obtain higher privileges on the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-033: Microsoft Excel Code Execution (886836)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Excel.
plugins.description:
The remote host has a version of Microsoft Excel that is vulnerable to
a code execution issue.  An attacker could exploit this flaw to execute
arbitrary code on the remote host with the privileges of the user
opening the file.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a malformed Excel
file to a victim on the remote host and wait for him to open it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Excel 2000 and 2002.

plugins.name: MS04-034: Vulnerability in zipped folders may allow code execution (873376)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Explorer.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows is vulnerable to a bug in the way it
handles compressed (zipped) folders, that could in turn be exploited by
an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially crafted
.zip file to a victim on the remote host and wait for him to browse the
file using the Windows Explorer.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS04-037: Vulnerability in Windows Shell (841356)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the Windows Shell that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to lure a victim into
visiting a malicious website or into opening a malicious file
attachment.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-029: Vulnerability in RPC Runtime Library Could Allow Information Disclosure and Denial of Service (873350)
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to crash the remote web server or retrieve sensitive
information.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows operating system contains a bug in RPC Runtime
Library.

RPC is a protocol used by Windows to provide an inter-process
communication mechanism that allows a program running on one system to
access services on another one.

A bug affecting the implementation of this protocol could allow an
attacker to cause it to crash, thus resulting in a crash of the whole
operating system, or to disclose random parts of the memory of the
remote host.

An attacker could exploit this flaw to obtain sensitive information
about the remote host, by forcing it to disclose portions of memory
containing passwords, or to cause it to crash repeatedly, thus causing a
denial of service for legitimate users.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a patch for Windows NT.

plugins.name: MS04-031: Vulnerability NetDDE Could Allow Code Execution (841533) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows is affected by a vulnerability in Network
Dynamic Data Exchange (NetDDE). 

An attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with the SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP, and 2003.

plugins.name: Samba Multiple Remote Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote service is vulnerable to several flaws.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is affected
by a remote denial of service vulnerability as well as a buffer
overflow. 

The Wild Card DoS vulnerability may allow an attacker to make the
remote server consume excessive CPU cycles. 

The QFILEPATHINFO Remote buffer overflow vulnerability may allow an
attacker to execute code on the server. 

An attacker needs a valid account or enough credentials to exploit
those flaws.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 3.0.8 or later.

plugins.name: MS04-039: ISA Server 2000 and Proxy Server 2.0 Internet Content Spoofing (888258)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to spoof the content of the remote proxy server.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running ISA Server 2000, an HTTP proxy.  The remote
version of this software is vulnerable to content spoofing attacks.

An attacker could lure a victim to visit a malicious website and the
user could believe is visiting a trusted web site.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for ISA Server 2000.

plugins.name: RealPlayer Skin File Remote Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application is affected by a remote buffer
overflow.
plugins.description:
According to its build number, the installed version of RealPlayer /
RealOne Player for Windows may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary
code on the remote host, with the privileges of the user running
RealPlayer because of an overflow vulnerability in the third-party
compression library 'DUNZIP32.DLL'. 

To do so, an attacker would need to send a corrupted skin file (.RJS)
to a remote user and have him open it using RealPlayer.
plugins.solution: Upgrade according to the vendor advisory referenced above.

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.07 IN_CDDA.dll m3u Playlist Processing Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a multimedia application that is
prone to a buffer overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp, a popular media player for Windows.

The version of Winamp installed on the remote Windows host has a
buffer overflow that may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code
on the remote host subject to the privileges of the user running
Winamp.

To exploit this, an attacker would have to send a malformed playlist
(.m3u) to a user of this host and trick him into loading it with the
application.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp version 5.07 or later.

plugins.name: SecureCRT telnet URI Arbitrary Configuration Folder Remote Command Execution
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary commands may be run through the remote service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using a vulnerable version of SecureCRT, a
SSH/Telnet client built for Microsoft Windows operation systems.

It has been reported that SecureCRT does not safely check the protocol
handler. As a result, an attacker may be able to exploit it by setting
up a malicious SMB share.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to SecureCRT 4.1.9 or newer.

plugins.name: SecureCRT SSH-1 Protocol Version String Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host has an application that is affected by a buffer
overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using a vulnerable version of SecureCRT, a
SSH/Telnet client built for Microsoft Windows operating systems.

It has been reported that SecureCRT contains a remote buffer overflow
allowing an SSH server to execute arbitrary commands via an especially
long SSH1 protocol version string.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to SecureCRT 3.2.2, 3.3.4, 3.4.6, 4.1 or newer

plugins.name: CuteFTP Professional FTP Command Response Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The FTP client installed on the remote Windows host has multiple
buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host has the program CuteFTP.exe installed.

CuteFTP is an FTP client which contains several buffer overflow
conditions.  Using this version of CuteFTP to connect to a malicious
FTP server could cause the client to crash, or could result in
arbitrary code execution.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to the latest version of CuteFTP.

plugins.name: MS04-040: Cumulative Security Update for Internet Explorer (889293)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Internet Explorer 6 SP1 that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to lure a victim on the
remote system into visiting a rogue website.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: Sun Java Applet Invocation Version Specification
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a runtime environment that is
affected by multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of the Java JRE
that is older than 1.4.2_06 / 1.3.1_13.

Even if a newer version of this software is installed, a malicious
Java applet may invoke a particular version of the Java JRE to be
executed with. As a result, a rogue Java applet could exploit this 
vulnerability by requesting to be executed with an older, vulnerable 
version of the JRE.
plugins.solution: Uninstall any outdated versions of the JRE.

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.0.7 Multiple File Handling DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote host is vulnerable to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp, a popular media player that handles
many file formats (mp3, wavs and more...)

The remote version of this software is vulnerable to denial of service
attacks when it processes malformed .mp4 / .m4a or .nsv / .nsa files. 

An attacker may exploit this flaw by sending malformed files to a
victim on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp version 5.0.7 or later.

plugins.name: MS04-045: WINS Code Execution (870763)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host via the WINS
service.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows Internet Naming Service (WINS) server is prone to a
heap overflow attack that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary
code on this host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially crafted
packet to port 42 of the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000 and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-044: Vulnerabilities in Windows Kernel and LSASS (885835)
plugins.synopsis: Local users can elevate their privileges on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running version of the NT kernel and LSASS which
could allow a local user to gain elevated privileged.

An attacker who has the ability to execute arbitrary commands on the
remote host could exploit these flaws to gain SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-043: Vulnerabilities in HyperTerminal (873339)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through
HyperTerminal.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the HyperTerminal software that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host by
tricking a victim into using Hyperterminal to log into a rogue host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS04-042: Windows NT Multiple DHCP Vulnerabilities (885249)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host via the DHCP
service.
plugins.description:
The remote host has the Windows DHCP server installed.

There is a flaw in the remote version of this server that could allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host with SYSTEM
privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT.

plugins.name: MS04-041: Vulnerabilities in WordPad (885836)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through WordPad.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of Microsoft WordPad that is
vulnerable to two security flaws.

To exploit these flaws an attacker would need to send a malformed Word
file to a victim on the remote host and wait for him to open the file
using WordPad.

Opening the file with WordPad will trigger a buffer overflow that could
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host with the
privileges of the user.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: Samba smbd Security Descriptor Parsing Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis: Remote code may be run on the remote server.
plugins.description:
The remote Samba server, according to its version number, is vulnerable to 
a remote buffer overrun resulting from an integer overflow vulnerability.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send to the remote host
a malformed packet containing hundreds of thousands of ACLs, which would
in turn cause an integer overflow resulting in a small pointer being allocated.

An attacker needs a valid account or enough credentials to exploit this
flaw.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Samba 3.0.10 or later.

plugins.name: Windows XP SP2 Firewall Critical Update (886185)
MS05-001: HTML Help Code Execution (890175)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the HTML Help ActiveX control
that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote
host by constructing a malicious web page and entice a victim to visit
this web page.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS05-002: Cursor and Icon Format Handling Code Execution (891711)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web or
email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Windows kernel that is
affected by a security flaw in the way that cursors and icons are
handled.  An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host by constructing a malicious web page and entice a victim to
visit this web page.  An attacker may send a malicious email to the
victim to exploit this flaw too.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS05-003: Indexing Service Code Execution (871250)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Indexing Service that may
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host by
constructing a malicious query.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.0.8c Multiple Unspecified Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The version of Winamp on the remote host has multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The version of Winamp installed on the remote host has various
unspecified vulnerabilities that may allow an attacker to execute
arbitrary code on the remote host. 

An attacker may exploit these flaws by sending malformed files to a
victim on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp 5.0.8c or later.

plugins.name: Trend Micro Antivirus Detection and Status
plugins.synopsis:
An antivirus application is installed on the remote host, but it is
not working properly.
plugins.description:
Trend Micro Antivirus, a commercial antivirus software package for
Windows, is installed on the remote host. However, there is a problem
with the installation; either its services are not running or its
engine and/or virus definitions are out of date.
plugins.solution:
Make sure that updates are working and the associated services are
running.

plugins.name: Antivirus Software Check
plugins.synopsis: An antivirus application is installed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
An antivirus application is installed on the remote host, and its
engine and virus definitions are up to date.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.03 Filename Handler Local Buffer Overflow
