plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote system.
plugins.description:
According to its version number, the VMware program on the remote host
may allow an attacker to execute code on the system hosting the VMware
instance. 

The vulnerability can be exploited by sending specially crafted FTP PORT
and EPRT requests. 

To be exploitable, the VMware system must be configured to use NAT
networking.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to :

- VMware Workstation 5.5.1 or higher
- VMware Workstation 4.5.2 or higher
- VMware Player 1.0.1 or higher
- VMware GSX Server 3.2.1 or higher.

plugins.name: AOL You've Got Pictures ActiveX Control (YGPPicFinder.DLL) Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that is affected by a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains an ActiveX control from AOL called YPG
Picture Finder Tool. It was distributed along with various versions of
AOL's client software and from the You've Got Pictures website prior
to 2004. The 'YGPPicFinder.DLL' component of this control fails to
limit the amount of user-supplied data copied to a finite buffer. This
can be exploited using a specially crafted web page, for example to
overflow the buffer, crash the application using the control
(typically Internet Explorer), and possibly execute arbitrary code
subject to the user's privileges.
plugins.solution: Download and run AOL's removal tool.

plugins.name: Symantec pcAnywhere Launch with Windows Caller Properties Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis:
The remote control software on the remote host is affected by a local
privilege escalation flaw.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running pcAnywhere, a remote control software
program for Windows. 

According to the Windows registry, the installed version of pcAnywhere
allows a local user to gain SYSTEM privileges by manipulating the
'Caller Properties' feature to run arbitrary commands when pcAnywhere
is configured to run as a service.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to pcAnywhere version 11.5 or later.

plugins.name: BitComet Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is a peer-to-peer file sharing application installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
BitComet is installed on the remote host. BitComet is a freeware
peer-to-peer file sharing application for Windows.

Make sure the use of this program fits with your corporate security
policy.
plugins.solution:
Deinstall this software if its use does not match your corporate
security policy.

plugins.name: BitComet Client .torrent URI Handling Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has a peer-to-peer application that is
affected by a remote buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of BitComet installed on the remote Windows host has a
buffer overflow flaw that could be triggered using a .torrent with a
specially crafted publisher's name to crash the application or even
execute arbitrary code remotely subject to the user's privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to BitComet 0.61 or later, or remove the application.

plugins.name: F-Secure ZIP/RAR Archive Handling Overflow Multiple RCE
plugins.synopsis:
An antivirus application installed on the remote host is affected by
multiple remote code execution vulnerabilities
plugins.description:
The version of F-Secure Anti-Virus installed on the remote Windows
host is affected by multiple flaws in the way it handles ZIP and RAR
archives. An attacker can exploit these, via specially crafted files,
to bypass scanning or execute arbitrary code with SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution:
Enable auto-updates if using F-Secure Internet Security 2004-2006,
F-Secure Anti-Virus 2004-2006, or F-Secure Personal Express version
6.20 or earlier. Alternatively, apply the appropriate hotfix as
referenced in the vendor advisory.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows Installed Software Enumeration (credentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to enumerate installed software.
plugins.solution:
Remove any applications that are not compliant with your organization's
acceptable use and security policies.

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.13 Playlist Handling Multiple Overflows
plugins.synopsis:
A multimedia application that is vulnerable to multiple buffer
overflows is installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp, a popular media player for Windows. 

It's possible that a remote attacker using a specially crafted M3U or
PLS file can cause a buffer overflow in the version of Winamp
installed on the remote Windows host, resulting in a crash of the
application and even execution of arbitrary code remotely subject to
the user's privileges.  Note that these issues can reportedly be
exploited without user interaction by linking to a '.pls' file in an
IFRAME tag.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp version 5.13 or later.

plugins.name: Adobe Reader Detection
plugins.synopsis: There is a PDF file viewer installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description: Adobe Reader, a PDF file viewer, is installed on the remote host.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: BitTorrent Installed
plugins.synopsis:
A peer-to-peer file sharing application is installed on the remote
Windows host.
plugins.description:
BitTorrent, peer-to-peer file sharing software, is installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if it does not comply with your corporate
security policy.

plugins.name: Vuze Installed
plugins.synopsis:
A peer-to-peer file sharing application is installed on the remote
Windows host.
plugins.description:
Vuze (formerly Azureus), peer-to-peer file sharing software, is
installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if it does not comply with your corporate
security policy.

plugins.name: BitLord Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is a peer-to-peer file sharing application installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
BitLord is installed on the remote Windows host. BitLord is a freeware
peer-to-peer file sharing application that supports the BitTorrent
protocol.

Make sure the use of this program fits with your corporate security
policy.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if its use does not match your corporate security
policy.

plugins.name: BitTornado Detection
plugins.synopsis:
There is a peer-to-peer file sharing application installed on the
remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
BitTornado is installed on the remote Windows host. BitTornado is a
peer-to-peer file sharing application that supports the BitTorrent
protocol.

Make sure the use of this program fits with your corporate security
policy.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if its use does not match your corporate security
policy.

plugins.name: Mozilla Foundation Application Detection
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains one or more applications from the
Mozilla Foundation.
plugins.description:
There is at least one instance of Firefox, Thunderbird, SeaMonkey, or
the Mozilla browser installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: Songbird Detection
plugins.synopsis: There is a media player installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
Songbird is installed on the remote host. Songbird is an open source
media player for Windows from the Songbird Project.

Make sure the use of this program fits with your corporate security
policy.
plugins.solution:
Remove this software if its use does not match your corporate security
policy.

plugins.name: MS02-012: Malformed Data Transfer Request can Cause Windows SMTP Service to Fail (313450)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the mail service.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a flaw in its SMTP service that could allow an
attacker to crash it.

Vulnerable services are SMTP service (Windows XP/Windows 2000) and
Exchange 2000 (Windows 2000).
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2000.

plugins.name: MS06-004: Cumulative Security Update for Internet Explorer (910620)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing the IE cumulative security update 910620.

The remote version of IE is vulnerable to several flaws that could
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS06-005: Vulnerability in Windows Media Player Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911565)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the Media
Player.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running either Windows Media Player 9.

There is a vulnerability in the remote version of this software that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to set up a rogue BMP
image and send it to a victim on the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-006: Vulnerability in Windows Media Player Plug-in Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911564)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Media
Player.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running the Windows Media Player plug-in.

There is a vulnerability in the remote version of this software that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially
crafted media file with a rogue EMBED element and have a user on the
affected host open it with the plug-in.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-007: Vulnerability in TCP/IP Could Allow Denial of Service (913446)
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to crash the remote host due to a flaw in the TCP/IP
stack.
plugins.description:
The remote host runs a version of Windows with a flaw in its TCP/IP
stack that could allow an attacker to perform a denial of service attack
against the remote host.

To exploit this vulnerability, an attacker needs to send a specially
crafted IGMP packet to the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003

plugins.name: MS06-008: Vulnerability in Web Client Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911927)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the Web Client
service that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need credentials to log into
the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-009: Vulnerability in Korean Input Method Could Allow Elevation of Privilege (901190)
plugins.synopsis: A local user may elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the Korean input
method that may allow a local attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need credentials to log into the
remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2003 and
Office 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-010: Vulnerability in PowerPoint 2000 Could Allow Information Disclosure (889167)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote version of PowerPoint is vulnerable to an information
disclosure attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of PowerPoint that is vulnerable to
an information disclosure attack.

Specifically, an attacker could send a malformed PowerPoint file to a
a victim on the remote host. When the victim opens the file, the
attacker may be able to obtain access to the files in the Temporary
Internet Files Folder of the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for PowerPoint.

plugins.name: Lotus Notes < 6.5.5 / 7.0.1 Attachment Handling Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows application is prone to multiple flaws.
plugins.description:
The version of Lotus Notes installed on the remote host reportedly
contains five buffer overflow vulnerabilities and one directory
traversal vulnerability in the KeyView viewers used to handle message
attachments. By sending specially crafted attachments to users of the
affected application and getting them to double-click and view the
attachment, an attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code subject
to the privileges under which the affected application runs or to
delete arbitrary files that are accessible to the NOTES user.
plugins.solution:
Either edit the 'keyview.ini' configuration file as described in the
vendor advisory above or upgrade to Lotus Notes version 6.5.5 / 7.0.1
or later.

plugins.name: MS06-008: Vulnerability in Web Client Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911927) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a flaw in the Web Client
service that may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need credentials to log into
the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2003.

plugins.name: BlackBerry Enterprise Service 10 / BlackBerry Enterprise Server / BlackBerry Unite! Detection
plugins.synopsis: A messaging service is installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
BlackBerry Enterprise Service 10, BlackBerry Enterprise Server, or
BlackBerry Unite! is installed on the remote host. These applications
are software suites for linking wireless networks and devices with
messaging and application servers.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: eStara SoftPhone Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows host is running a SIP client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running eStara SoftPhone, a commercial SIP software
client for Windows.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: eStara SoftPhone SIP Packet SDP Data attribute Field Overflow
plugins.synopsis: The remote SIP client is prone to a buffer overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The version of SoftPhone installed on the remote host reportedly fails
to properly handle SIP packets with long 'a=' lines in the SDP data. 
An unauthenticated, remote attacker may be able to exploit this flaw to
overflow a buffer and execute arbitrary code on the remote host.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to eStara SoftPhone version 3.0.1.47 or later.

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.2 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
A multimedia application that is vulnerable to denial of service
attacks is installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp, a popular media player for Windows. 

The version of Winamp installed on the remote Windows host reportedly
crashes if the user tries to open an M3U file with a long filename. 

In addition, it reportedly contains a buffer overflow flaw that can be
exploited using a specially crafted M3U file to either crash the
application or possibly even execute arbitrary code remotely.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp version 5.2 or later.

plugins.name: ShockWave Player ActiveX Installer Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that is affected by a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains an ActiveX control associated with
Macromedia's ShockWave Player installer that has an exploitable
stack-based buffer overflow. It may be possible for an attacker to
execute arbitrary code on the remote host subject to the user's
privileges by tricking a user into visiting a malicious website.
plugins.solution:
The vendor claims the issue occurs only in the installer and that
there is no need for action.

plugins.name: Visnetic AntiVirus Plug-in for MailServer Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application is prone to a local privilege
escalation issue.
plugins.description:
The version of VisNetic AntiVirus Plug-in for MailServer installed on
the remote host does not drop its privileges before invoking other
programs. An attacker with local access can exploit this flaw to
execute arbitrary programs on the affected host with LOCAL SYSTEM
privileges.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to VisNetic AntiVirus Plug-in for VisNetic MailServer version
4.6.1.2 or later.

plugins.name: MS06-011: Permissive Windows Services DACLs Could Allow Elevation of Privilege (914798)
plugins.synopsis:
Local users may be able to elevate their privileges on the remote
host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains services whose permissions are
set to such a way that low-privileged local users may be able to
change properties associated to each service and therefore manage to
elevate their privileges.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need credentials to log into
the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-012: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office Could Allow Remote Code Execution (905413)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Office.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Office that could
allow arbitrary code to be run.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have him open it.  Then a bug in the font
parsing handler would result in code execution.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: Flash Player swf Processing Multiple Unspecified Code Execution (APSB06-03)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a browser plugin that is affected by
several critical flaws.
plugins.description:
According to its version number, the instance of Flash Player on the
remote Windows host contains multiple critical and as-yet unspecified
vulnerabilities that could allow an attacker to take control of the
affected host.  To exploit these issues, a user must load a malicious
SWF file in Flash Player.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Flash Player version 8.0.24.0 / 7.0.63.0 or later.

plugins.name: RealPlayer for Windows < Build 6.0.12.1483 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows application is affected by several issues.
plugins.description:
According to its build number, the installed version of RealPlayer /
RealOne Player / RealPlayer Enterprise on the remote Windows host
suffers from one or more buffer overflows involving maliciously-
crafted SWF and MBC files as well as web pages.  In addition, it also
may be affected by a local privilege escalation issue.
plugins.solution: Upgrade according to the vendor advisory referenced above.

plugins.name: Rhapsody SWF File Handling Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows application is affected by a buffer overflow flaw.
plugins.description:
According to its version number, the installed version of Rhapsody on
the remote host suffers from a buffer overflow involving SWF files. 
To exploit this issue, a remote attacker needs to convince a user to
attempt to play a maliciously crafted SWF file using the affected
application.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Rhapsody 3 build 1.0.270 or later.

plugins.name: Spybot Search & Destroy Detection
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has a spyware detection program installed on
it.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows host is running Spybot Search & Destroy, a privacy
enhancing application that can detect and remove spyware of different
kinds from your computer.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: ZoneAlarm VSMON.exe Local Privilege Escalation
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application is prone to a local privilege
escalation issue.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running ZoneAlarm, a firewall for Windows.

The TrueVector service associated with the version of ZoneAlarm
installed on the remote host loads as part of its startup several
necessary DLLs without specifying their pathnames. An attacker with
local access can exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary programs on
the affected host with LOCAL SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to ZoneAlarm build 6.1.744.001 or later.

plugins.name: GlobalSCAPE Secure FTP Server (gsftps) Custom Command Long Parameter DoS
plugins.synopsis: The remote FTP server is prone to denial of service attacks.
plugins.description:
GlobalSCAPE Secure FTP Server is installed on the remote Windows host. 

According to the registry, the version of GlobalSCAPE Secure FTP
Server on the remote host is affected by a denial of service
vulnerability involving a lengthy parameter line to an unspecified
custom command.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to GlobalSCAPE Secure FTP Server 3.1.4 Build 01.10.2006 or
later.

plugins.name: MS05-047: Plug and Play Remote Code Execution and Local Privilege Elevation (905749) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
A flaw in the Plug and Play service may allow an authenticated
attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host and, therefore,
elevate his privileges.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Plug and Play service that
contains a vulnerability in the way it handles user-supplied data.

An authenticated attacker may exploit this flaw by sending a malformed
RPC request to the remote service and execute code with SYSTEM
privileges.

Note that authentication is not required against Windows 2000 if the
MS05-039 patch is missing.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000 and XP.

plugins.name: Microsoft Commerce Server 2002 authfiles/login.asp Authentication Bypass
plugins.synopsis:
The remote web application may be vulnerable to an authentication
bypass attack.
plugins.description:
The version of Microsoft Commerce Server 2002 installed on the remote
host may enable an attacker to bypass authentication if the sample
files from the 'AuthFiles' folder are installed under the web server's
document root. 

Note that successful exploitation of this issue requires knowledge of
the location of the sample files as well as a valid user name.
plugins.solution: Apply Commerce Server 2002 Service Pack 2 or later.

plugins.name: MS06-013: Cumulative Security Update for Internet Explorer (912812)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing IE Cumulative Security Update 912812.

The remote version of IE is vulnerable to several flaws that could allow
an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-014: Vulnerability in MDAC Could Allow Code Execution (911562)
plugins.synopsis:
A local administrator could elevate his privileges on the remote host, through a
flaw in the MDAC server.
plugins.description:
The remote Microsoft Data Access Component (MDAC) server is vulnerable to a
flaw that could allow a local administrator to elevate his privileges to the
'system' level, thus gaining the complete control over the remote system.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-015: Vulnerabilities in Windows Explorer Could Allow Remote Code Execution (908531)
plugins.synopsis:
Vulnerabilities in the Windows Explorer could allow an attacker to execute
arbitrary code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of the Windows Explorer
that has a vulnerability in the way it handles COM objects.
An attacker could exploit this vulnerability by asking a victim to visit
a rogue website containing a malformed COM object.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-016: Vulnerability in Outlook Express Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911567)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the email
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Outlook Express that
may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a malformed
Windows Address Book (.wab) file to a victim on the remote host and
have him open the file.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Outlook Express.

plugins.name: Opera < 8.54 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains a web browser that is prone to a buffer
overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Opera, an alternative web browser. 

The version of Opera installed on the remote host contains a buffer
overflow that can be triggered by a long value within a stylesheet
attribute.  Successful exploitation can lead to a browser crash and
possibly allow for the execution of arbitrary code subject to the
privileges of the user running Opera.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Opera 8.54 or later.

plugins.name: MS06-017: FrontPage fpadmdll.dll Multiple Parameter XSS (917627)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote web server contains a server extension that is affected by
a cross-site scripting vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of Microsoft FrontPage Server Extensions 2002 / SharePoint
Team Services on the remote host is affected by a cross-site scripting
(XSS) vulnerability due to improper sanitization of user-supplied
input to the 'operation', 'command', and 'name' parameters to file
/_vti_bin/_vti_adm/fpadmdll.dll before using the input to generate
dynamic HTML. A remote attacker can exploit this issue to cause
arbitrary HTML and script code to be executed in a user's browser
session in the context of the affected website.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Frontapage 2002 for XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-018: Vulnerability in MSDTC Could Allow Denial of Service (913580)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to crash the remote MSDTC service.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of MSDTC that contains
several denial of service vulnerabilities (DoS and Invalid Memory
Access).

An attacker may exploit these flaws to crash the remote service.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-019: Vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Could Allow Remote Code Execution (916803)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the email server.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Exchange that is vulnerable to
a bug in the vCal or iCal attachment handling routine that could allow
an attacker execute arbitrary code on the remote host by sending a
specially crafted email.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Exchange 2000 and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-018: Vulnerability in Microsoft Distributed Transaction Coordinator Could Allow DoS (913580) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: A vulnerability in MSDTC could allow remote code execution.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of MSDTC (Microsoft
Data Transaction Coordinator) service that is affected by several
remote code execution and denial of service vulnerabilities.

An attacker may exploit these flaws to obtain complete control of the
remote host (2000, NT4) or to crash the remote service (XP, 2003).
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: I-Nav VUpdater.Install ActiveX Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that is affected by a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains an ActiveX control, 'VUpdater.Install',
associated with Verisign I-Nav, which provides support for
Internationalized Domain Names in Microsoft Internet Explorer, Outlook
and Outlook Express that reportedly contains a buffer overflow
vulnerability that arises when processing CAB files. A remote attacker
may be able to leverage this issue to specify an arbitrary executable
to be run subject to the privileges of the current user.
plugins.solution: Download the latest version of the software from the vendor.

plugins.name: Novell Client for Windows DPRPC library (DPRPCW32.DLL) ndps_xdr_array Function Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a DLL that suffers from a buffer
overflow flaw.
plugins.description:
The file 'dprpcw32.dll' included with the Novell Client software
reportedly contains a potential buffer overflow.
plugins.solution:
Install the 491psp2_dprpcw32.exe beta patch file referenced in the
vendor advisory above.

plugins.name: QuickTime < 7.1 Multiple Vulnerabilities (Windows)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote version of QuickTime is affected by multiple overflow
vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows host is running a version of QuickTime prior to
7.1. 

The remote version of QuickTime is vulnerable to various integer and
buffer overflows involving specially crafted image and media files. 
An attacker may be able to leverage these issues to execute arbitrary
code on the remote host by sending a malformed file to a victim and
having him open it using QuickTime player.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to QuickTime version 7.1 or later.

plugins.name: QuickTime for Windows Detection
plugins.synopsis: There is a media player installed on the remote Windows host.
plugins.description:
QuickTime is installed on the remote host. QuickTime is a popular
media player / plug-in that handles various types of music and video
files.
plugins.solution:
Make sure use of this program agrees with your organization's
acceptable use and security policies.

plugins.name: FileZilla FTP Client Unspecified Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an application is that affected by a 
remote buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
According to its version, the FileZilla FTP client installed on the
remote host is affected by an unspecified buffer overflow
vulnerability.  It may be possible to exploit this issue remotely by
tricking a user into connecting to a malicious FTP site using the
affected client. Remote code execution would then be possible subject
to the user's privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to FileZilla client version 2.2.23 or later.

plugins.name: FileZilla FTP Server MLSD Command Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an application that is suffers from a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
According to its version, the FileZilla Server Interface installed on
the remote host is affected by an unspecified buffer overflow
vulnerability, which could be leveraged by an attacker to execute
arbitrary code subject to the privileges of the user running the
affected application.

Note that to successfully exploit this remotely, the application would
need to be configured to accept remote connections, which it does not
by default.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to FileZilla Server version 0.9.17 or later.

plugins.name: Skype URI Handling Arbitrary File Download (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Skype client is affected by an information disclosure
issue.
plugins.description:
The version of Skype installed on the remote host reportedly may allow
a remote attacker to initiate a file transfer to another Skype user by
means of a specially crafted Skype URL.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Skype release 2.0.*.105 / 2.5.*.79 or later.

plugins.name: NOD32 Antivirus Detection and Status
plugins.synopsis:
An antivirus application is installed on the remote host, but it is
not working properly.
plugins.description:
NOD32 Antivirus, a commercial antivirus software package for Windows,
is installed on the remote host. However, there is a problem with the
installation; either its services are not running or its engine and/or
virus definitions are out of date.
plugins.solution:
Make sure that updates are working and the associated services are
running.

plugins.name: ZipCentral ZIP File Handling Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an application that is suffers from a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
According to its version, the ZipCentral program installed on the
remote host is affected by a stack-based buffer overflow when handling
a ZIP file with specially crafted filenames.
plugins.solution: Unknown at this time.

plugins.name: wodSFTP ActiveX Arbitrary File Access
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that allows arbitrary
access to the filesystem.
plugins.description:
The Windows remote host contains the wodSFTP ActiveX control, which
provides SFTP functionality to applications that use it and is marked
as 'safe for scripting'. A remote attacker may be able to use this
control to store files on the remote filesystem or retrieve files from
it by means of a specially crafted HTML page or email and without any
further interaction from the user.
plugins.solution:
Disable the use of this ActiveX control from within Internet Explorer
by setting its kill bit.

plugins.name: Microsoft Windows 95/98/ME Unsupported Installation Detection
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Windows that is no
longer supported by Microsoft.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Windows 9x (95, 98,
or ME). Windows 95 support ended on December 31, 2001. Windows 98/ME
support ended on July 11, 2006.

Lack of support implies that no new security patches for the operating
system will be released by the vendor. As a result, it is likely to
contain security vulnerabilities.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to a version of Windows that is currently supported.

plugins.name: F-Secure Multiple Products Web Console Pre-authentication Overflow RCE
plugins.synopsis:
An antivirus application installed on the remote host is affected by a
remote code execution vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of F-Secure Internet Gatekeeper and/or F-Secure Anti-Virus
for Microsoft Exchange installed on the remote host is affected by a
buffer overflow condition in its web console. An unauthenticated,
remote attacker can exploit this to cause a denial of service
condition or the execution of arbitrary code.

Note that the web console by default accepts connections only from the
local host; therefore, this issue can be exploited remotely only if
the web console has been specifically configured to accept connections
remotely.
plugins.solution: Apply the appropriate hotfix as described in the vendor advisory.

plugins.name: MS04-012: Cumulative Update for Microsoft RPC/DCOM (828741) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host has multiple bugs in its RPC/DCOM implementation
(828741).

An attacker may exploit one of these flaws to execute arbitrary code
on the remote system.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-021: Cumulative Security Update for Internet Explorer (916281)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing the IE cumulative security update 916281.

The remote version of IE is vulnerable to several flaws that could
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-022: Vulnerability in ART Image Rendering Could Allow Remote Code Execution (918439)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in the Hyperlink Object Library.

An attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to construct a malicious
hyperlink and lure a victim into clicking it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-023: Vulnerability in Microsoft JScript Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917344)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web or
email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in JScript.

An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the remote host
by constructing a malicious JScript and enticing a victim to visit a
website or view a specially crafted email message.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-024: Vulnerability in Windows Media Player Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917734)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the Media Player.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Windows Media Player.

There is a vulnerability in the remote version of this software that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, one attacker would need to set up a rogue PNG
image and send it to a victim on the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-025: Vulnerability in Routing and Remote Access Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911280)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of RRAS (Routing and
Remote Access Service) that has several memory corruption
vulnerabilities.

An attacker may exploit these flaws to execute code on the remote
service.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-027: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Word Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917336)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Word.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Word that is subject
to a flaw that could allow arbitrary code to be run.

An attacker may use this to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it open it.  Then a bug in the font parsing
handler would result in code execution.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Word 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-028: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft PowerPoint Could Allow Remote Code Execution (916768)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
PowerPoint.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft PowerPoint that is
subject to a fla that could allow arbitrary code to be run.

An attacker may use this to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it open it.  Then a bug in the font parsing
handler would result in code execution.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for PowerPoint 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-030: Vulnerability in Server Message Block Could Allow Elevation of Privilege (914389)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of SMB (Server
Message Block) protocol that is affected by several vulnerabilities.

An attacker may exploit these flaws to elevate his privileges and gain
control of the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-031: Vulnerability in RPC Mutual Authentication Could Allow Spoofing (917736)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to spoof an RPC server.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of SMB (Server
Message Block) protocol that is vulnerable to a spoofing attack.

An attacker may exploit these flaws to enduce a user to connect to
a malicious RPC server.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS06-032: Vulnerability in TCP/IP Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917953)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of the TCP/IP
protocol that is vulnerable to a buffer overflow attack.

An attacker may exploit these flaws to execute code on the remote
host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-029: Vulnerability in Microsoft Exchange Server Running Outlook Web Access Could Allow Script Injection (912442)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Web Server contains a script that is vulnerable to script injection
attacks.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the Outlook Web Access that contains
cross-site scripting flaws.

This vulnerability could allow an attacker to convince a user
to run a malicious script. If this malicious script is run, it would execute
in the security context of the user.
Attempts to exploit this vulnerability require user interaction.

This vulnerability could allow an attacker access to any data on the
Outlook Web Access server that was accessible to the individual user.

It may also be possible to exploit the vulnerability to manipulate Web browser caches
and intermediate proxy server caches, and put spoofed content in those caches.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a patch for OWA for Exchange 2000/2003.

plugins.name: MS06-025: Vulnerability in Routing and Remote Access Could Allow Remote Code Execution (911280) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis: It is possible to execute code on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows contains a version of RRAS (Routing and
Remote Access Service) that is affected by several memory corruption
vulnerabilities.

An attacker may exploit these flaws to execute code on the remote
service.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: PicoZip ZipInfo.dll Filename Handling Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains an application that is affected by a
buffer overflow.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running PicoZip, a file compression utility for
Windows. 

According to the registry, the version of PicoZip installed on the
remote Windows host fails to properly check the size of filenames
before copying them into a finite-sized buffer within the
'zipinfo.dll' info tip shell extension.  Using a specially crafted
ACE, RAR, or ZIP file, an attacker may be able to exploit this issue
to execute arbitrary code on the affected host subject to the
privileges of the user running the affected application.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to PicoZip version 4.02 or later.

plugins.name: Adobe Reader < 7.0.8 Multiple Unspecified Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: The PDF file viewer on the remote Windows host is affected by several issues.
plugins.description:
The version of Adobe Reader installed on the remote host is earlier than 7.0.8
and thus reportedly is affected by several security issues. While details on
the nature of these flaws is currently unknown, the vendor ranks them low,
saying they have minimal impact and are difficult to exploit.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Adobe Reader 7.0.8 or later.

plugins.name: Symantec Antivirus Software Detection and Status
plugins.synopsis: An antivirus application is installed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
A Symantec antivirus application is installed on the remote host.

Note that this plugin checks that the application is running properly
and that its latest virus definitions are loaded.
plugins.solution:
Ensure that updates are working and the associated services are
running.

plugins.name: Webroot SpySweeper Enterprise Detection
Winamp < 5.22 Malformed Midi File Handling Buffer Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a multimedia application that is
prone to a buffer overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp, a popular media player for Windows. 

The version of Winamp installed on the remote Windows host reportedly
contains a buffer overflow in the 'in_midi.dll' library that can be
exploited using a specially crafted MIDI file to either crash the
affected application or possibly even execute arbitrary code remotely,
subject to the privileges of the user running the application.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp version 5.22 or later.

plugins.name: Winamp < 5.24 in_midi.dll MIDI File Processing Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a multimedia application that is
prone to a buffer overflow attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is using Winamp, a popular media player for Windows. 

The version of Winamp installed on the remote Windows host reportedly
contains a buffer overflow in the MIDI plugin ('in_midi.dll') that can
be exploited using a MIDI file with a specially crafted header to
crash the affected application or possibly even execute arbitrary code
remotely, subject to the privileges of the user running the
application.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Winamp version 5.24 or later.

plugins.name: Opera Browser Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote Windows host contains an alternative web browser.
plugins.description:
Opera, an alternative web browser, is installed on the remote Windows
host.
plugins.solution: n/a

plugins.name: WebWasher Remote ARJ Decoder Malformed Archive Handling DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an application that is affected by a
denial of service vulnerability.
plugins.description:
According to its version, the version of WebWasher installed on the
remote host is affected by a denial of service vulnerability when
handling a specially crafted ARJ file.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to WebWasher 5.3.0 build 2252 or later.

plugins.name: Gracenote CDDBControl ActiveX Control Option String Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that is susceptible to
a buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The Windows remote host contains the Gracenote CDDBControl ActiveX
control, which is used by various products, including AOL's software,
to lookup CD information in the Gracenote CDDB and is commonly marked
as safe for scripting.

The version of this ActiveX control on the remote host reportedly
contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that arises when a large
string is supplied as an option for the control. A remote attacker may
be able to leverage this issue to execute arbitrary code on the remote
host subject to the privileges of the current user.
plugins.solution:
Contact the developer of the software you are using for a patch or new
version; otherwise, use Gracenote's tool to set its kill bit to
disable the control in Internet Explorer.

plugins.name: Apple iTunes AAC File Parsing Integer Overflow (credentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains an application that is affected by a
remote code execution flaw.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running Apple iTunes, a popular media player.

The remote version of iTunes is vulnerable to an integer overflow when
it parses a specially crafted AAC file. By tricking a user into
opening such a file, a remote attacker may be able to leverage this
issue to execute arbitrary code on the affected host, subject to the
privileges of the user running the application.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Apple iTunes 6.0.5 or later.

plugins.name: OpenOffice < 2.0.3 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through OpenOffice.org.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of OpenOffice.org which is older than 
version 2.0.3.

An attacker may use this to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of the 
remote computer and have him open it. The file could be crafted in such a
way that it could exploit a buffer overflow in OpenOffice.org's XML parser,
or by containing rogue macros.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to OpenOffice.org 2.0.3 or newer.

plugins.name: Opera < 9.00 Multiple Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote host contains a web browser that is affected by multiple
issues.
plugins.description:
The version of Opera installed on the remote host reportedly contains
an issue that presents itself when the height and width parameters of
a JPEG image are set excessively high, causing Opera to allocate
insufficient memory for the image and crash as it tries to write to
memory at the wrong location. 

In addition, it is reportedly affected by a flaw that may allow an
attacker to display an SSL certificate from a trusted site on an
untrusted one.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Opera version 9.00 or later.

plugins.name: Novell GroupWise Windows Client Arbitrary Email Access
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a mail client that may allow
unauthorized access to email messages.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running GroupWise, an enterprise-class
collaboration application from Novell. 

The version of GroupWise installed on the remote host contains a flaw
in the client API that may allow a user to bypass security controls
and gain access to non-authorized email within the same authenticated
post office.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to GroupWise 6.5 SP6 Update 1 / 7 SP1 or later.

plugins.name: Microsoft Internet Explorer Unsupported Version Detection
plugins.synopsis: The remote host contains an unsupported version of Internet Explorer.
plugins.description:
According to its self-reported version number, the installation of
Microsoft Internet Explorer on the remote Windows host is no longer
supported.

Lack of support implies that no new security patches for the product
will be released by the vendor. As a result, it is likely to contain
security vulnerabilities.
plugins.solution:
Either Upgrade to a version of Internet Explorer that is currently supported
or disable Internet Explorer on the target device.

plugins.name: MS06-033: Vulnerabilities in ASP.NET could allow information disclosure (917283)
plugins.synopsis:
An attacker may bypass ASP.NET security to gain unauthorized access to objects
in the remote application folder.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the ASP.NET framework that contains
a flaw that could allow an attacker to bypass the security of an ASP.NET website
by accessing protected objects by their explicit names.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-034: Vulnerability in Microsoft IIS using ASP Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917537)
plugins.synopsis:
It is possible to use the remote web server to exploit arbitrary code on the
remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows and IIS that is
vulnerable to a flaw that could allow an attacker who has the
privileges to upload arbitrary ASP scripts to it to execute arbitrary
code.

Specifically, the remote version of IIS is vulnerable to a flaw when
parsing specially crafted ASP files.  By uploading a malicious ASP file
on the remote host, an attacker may be able to take the complete control
of the remote system.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-035: Vulnerability in Server Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917159)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
'server' service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is vulnerable to heap overflow in the 'Server' service that
could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host with
the 'System' privileges.

In addition to this, the remote host is also vulnerable to an
information disclosure attack in SMB that could allow an attacker to
obtain portions of the memory of the remote host.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-036: Vulnerability in DHCP Client Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (914388)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
DHCP client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a DHCP client that is vulnerable to a buffer
overrun attack when receiving a malformed response to a DHCP request.

An attacker could exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with 'SYSTEM' privileges.

Typically, the attacker would need to be on the same physical subnet
as this victim to exploit this flaw.  Also, the victim needs to be
configured to use DHCP.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-037: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Excel Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917285)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Excel.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Excel that could
allow arbitrary code to be run.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have him open it with Microsoft Excel.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Excel 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-038: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917284)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Office.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Office that could
allow arbitrary code to be run on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have him open it with Microsoft Office.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-039: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office Filters Could Allow Remote Code Execution (915384)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the
Microsoft Office filters.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of some Microsoft Office filters
that are subject to various flaws which could allow arbitrary code to
be run.

An attacker could use these to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it import it with Microsoft Office.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-035: Vulnerability in Server Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917159) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
'Server' service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is vulnerable to heap overflow in the 'Server' service
that may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote
host with 'SYSTEM' privileges.

In addition to this, the remote host is also affected by an
information disclosure vulnerability in SMB that may allow an attacker
to obtain portions of the memory of the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: Adobe Acrobat < 6.0.5 PDF Distillation Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains an application that is affected by
several issues.
plugins.description:
The version of Adobe Acrobat installed on the remote host is earlier
than 6.0.5 and is reportedly affected by a buffer overflow that may be
triggered when distilling a specially crafted file to PDF.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to Adobe Acrobat 6.0.5 or later.

plugins.name: WebEx Downloader ActiveX Control Command Injection
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that allows for
arbitrary code execution.
plugins.description:
The Windows remote host contains the WebEx Downloader ActiveX control,
which is used when attending or hosting a meeting using WebEx, a
sharing and conferencing application for Windows.

The version of this ActiveX control on the remote host reportedly
allows an attacker to deliver arbitrary components to the affected
host, which could later be executed subject to the privileges of the
current user.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to WebEx Downloader plugin 2.1.0.0 or later.

plugins.name: Flash Player Multiple Vulnerabilities (APSB06-11)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a browser plugin that is affected by
multiple issues.
plugins.description:
According to its version number, the instance of Flash Player on the
remote Windows host is affected by arbitrary code execution and denial
of service issues.  By convincing a user to visit a site with a
specially crafted SWF file, an attacker may be able to execute
arbitrary code on the affected host or cause the web browser to crash.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to Flash Player version 9.0.16.0 / 8.0.33.0 / 7.0.66.0 /
6.0.88.0 or later.

plugins.name: WinRAR LHA Filename Handling Buffer Overflows
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an application that is suffers from two
buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running WinRAR, an archive manager for Windows.

The version of WinRAR installed on the remote host is affected by two
stack-based buffer overflows when processing LHA files with specially-
crafted filenames. Successful exploitation of either issue enables an
attacker to execute arbitrary code subject to the privileges of the
current user.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to WinRAR version 3.6.0 beta 7 (3.60.7.0) or later.

plugins.name: Intel PRO/Wireless Network Connection Drivers Remote Code Execution Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Intel Wireless/PRO 2200/2915
driver that is is affected by a memory corruption vulnerability. An
attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on the remote
host with kernel privileges or to disable the remote service remotely.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially
crafted wireless frame to the remote host.
plugins.solution: http://security-center.intel.com/advisory.aspx?intelid=INTEL-SA-00001

plugins.name: Intel PRO/Wireless 2100 Network Connection Driver Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Intel Wireless/PRO 2100 driver
that is fails to properly handle certain malformed frames. A local
attacker may exploit this flaw to elevate his privileges (SYSTEM) on
the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a specially
crafted wireless frame to the Intel driver.
plugins.solution: http://www.nessus.org/u?58136174

plugins.name: CA eTrust Antivirus WebScan ActiveX Control Vulnerabilities
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that is affected by
multiple vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The Windows remote host contains the WebScan ActiveX control, which is
used by Computer Associates' eTrust Antivirus WebScan service.

The version of this ActiveX control on the remote host reportedly
contains a buffer overflow and fails to properly validate parameters.
Exploitation of these issues may allow an unauthenticated, remote
attacker to execute arbitrary code or gain privileged access.
plugins.solution:
Either remote the control or upgrade to WebScan v1.1.0.1048 or later
by visiting http://www3.ca.com/securityadvisor/virusinfo/scan.aspx and
allowing Internet Explorer to update a new version of webscan.cab.

plugins.name: MS06-040: Vulnerability in Server Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (921883)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
'server' service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is vulnerable to a buffer overrun in the 'Server'
service that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with 'SYSTEM' privileges.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-041: Vulnerability in DNS Resolution Could Allow Remote Code Execution (920683)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
DNS client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is vulnerable to a buffer overrun in the DNS client
service that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with SYSTEM privileges.

To exploit this vulnerability, an attacker would need to set up a
rogue DNS server to reply to the client with a specially crafted
packet.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-042: Cumulative Security Update for Internet Explorer (918899)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is missing IE Cumulative Security Update 918899.

The remote version of IE is vulnerable to several flaws that could
allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote host.

Note that Microsoft has re-released this hotfix since the initial
version contained a buffer overflow.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-043: Vulnerability in Microsoft Windows Could Allow Remote Code Execution (920214)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the email
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Outlook Express
that contains a security flaw that could allow an attacker to execute
arbitrary code on the remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to send a malformed HTML
email to a victim on the remote host and have him open it.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Outlook Express.

plugins.name: MS06-044: Vulnerability in Microsoft Management Console Could Allow Remote Code Execution (917008)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web or
email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in the Management Console.

An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the remote host
by constructing a malicious script and enticing a victim to visit a
website or view a specially crafted email message.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS06-045: Vulnerability in Windows Explorer Could Allow Remote Code Execution (921398)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web or
email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in the Windows Explorer Drag & Drop handler.

An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the remote host
by constructing a malicious script and enticing a victim to visit a
website or view a specially crafted email message and save a file.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-046: Vulnerability in HTML Help Could Allow Remote Code Execution (922616)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the HTML Help ActiveX control
that could allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the remote
host by constructing a malicious web page and entice a victim to visit
this web page.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-047: Vulnerability in Microsoft Visual Basic for Applications Could Allow Remote Code Execution (921645)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through VBA.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Visual Basic for
Applications that is vulnerable to a buffer overflow when handling
malformed documents.

An attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on this
host by sending a malformed file to a user of the remote host.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office.

plugins.name: MS06-048: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office Could Allow Remote Code Execution (922968)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Office.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Office that could
allow arbitrary code execution.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have him open it with Microsoft Office.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Office 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-049: Vulnerability in Windows Kernel Could Result in Elevation of Privilege (920958)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Windows kernel that could
allow a local user to elevate his privileges or to crash it (therefore
causing a denial of service).
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000.

plugins.name: MS06-050: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Windows Hyperlink Object Library Could Allow Remote Code Execution (920670)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web
client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in the Hyperlink Object Library.

An attacker could exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host.

To exploit this flaw, an attacker would need to construct a malicious
hyperlink and lure a victim into clicking it.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-051: Vulnerability in Windows Kernel Could Result in Remote Code Execution (917422)
plugins.synopsis: A local user can elevate his privileges on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote host contains a version of the Windows kernel that could
allow a local user to elevate his privileges or to crash it (therefore
causing a denial of service).
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-040: Vulnerability in Server Service Could Allow Remote Code Execution (921883) (uncredentialed check)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
'Server' service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is vulnerable to a buffer overrun in the 'Server'
service that may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with 'SYSTEM' privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: Symantec Backup Exec Multiple Heap Overflow RCE (SYM06-014)
plugins.synopsis:
An application installed on the remote host is affected by multiple
remote code execution vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The Windows remote host contains Symantec Backup Exec for Windows
Server or Backup Exec Continuous Protection Server, a commercial
backup product. The version of the software installed on the remote
host is affected by multiple heap overflow conditions involving
specially crafted calls to its RPC interfaces. An authenticated,
remote attacker can exploit these issues to crash the affected
application or execute arbitrary code with elevated privileges.
plugins.solution: Apply the appropriate hotfix as referenced in the vendor advisory.

plugins.name: IBM eGatherer ActiveX RunEgatherer Function Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host has an ActiveX control that is affected by a
buffer overflow vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The Windows remote host contains the eGatherer ActiveX control, which
is typically installed by default on IBM workstations and laptops and
used for automatically locating drivers and updates on IBM / Lenovo
support sites.

The version of this ActiveX control on the remote host reportedly
contains a stack-based buffer overflow in the 'RunEgatherer' function.
Exploitation of this issue may allow an unauthenticated remote
attacker to execute arbitrary code subject to the user's privileges.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to version 3.20.284.0 or later of the ActiveX control.

plugins.name: Compression Plus CP5DLL32.DLL ZOO Archive Header Processing Overflow RCE
plugins.synopsis:
A library file installed on the remote Windows host is affected by a
remote code execution vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The version of the Compression Plus toolkit installed on the remote
Windows host contains a DLL file that is affected by a stack-based
overflow condition when processing specially crafted ZOO files. A
remote attacker can exploit this issue, via an inconsistent size
parameter in a ZOO file header, to execute arbitrary code.
plugins.solution:
Contact the vendor for a fix or upgrade file Cp5dll32.dll to version
5.0.1.28 or later.

plugins.name: DynaZip < 5.0.0.8 / 6.0.0.5 Zip Archive Handling Multiple Overflows
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows host contains a library that is affected by several
buffer overflow vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The version of the DynaZip Max or DynaZip Max Secure installed on the
remote host contains a DLL that reportedly is prone to stack-based
overflows when repairing or updating a specially crafted ZIP file.
Successful exploitation allows an attacker to execute arbitrary code
on the affected host subject to the user's privileges.

Note that DynaZip libraries are included in some third-party
applications to provide support for handling ZIP files.
plugins.solution:
Either upgrade to DynaZip Max 5.0.0.8 / DynaZip Max Secure 6.0.0.5 or
later or contact the appropriate vendor for a fix.

plugins.name: Microsoft Exchange Server Unsupported Version Detection
plugins.synopsis:
The Microsoft Exchange Server running on the remote host is no longer
supported.
plugins.description:
According to its self-reported version number, the installation of
Microsoft Exchange Server on the remote host is no longer supported.

Lack of support implies that no new security patches for the product
will be released by the vendor. As a result, it is likely to contain
security vulnerabilities.
plugins.solution:
Upgrade to a version of Microsoft Exchange Server that is currently
supported.

plugins.name: MS06-052: Vulnerability in Pragmatic General Multicast (PGM) Could Allow Remote Code Execution (919007)
plugins.synopsis: Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host.
plugins.description:
The remote version of Windows is affected by a vulnerability in the
Pragmatic General Multicast protocol installed with the MSMQ service.

An attacker may exploit this flaw to execute arbitrary code on the
remote host with KERNEL privileges.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows XP.

plugins.name: MS06-053: Vulnerability in Indexing Service Could Allow XSS (920685)
plugins.synopsis: The remote web server is vulnerable to a cross-site scripting attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the Indexing service that fails
to adequately sanitize some requests.  Combined with a web server using
this service, this flaw could be exploited by an attacker who would be
able to cause arbitrary HTML and script code to be executed in a user's
browser within the security context of the affected site.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows NT, 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-054: Vulnerability in Microsoft Publisher Could Allow Remote Code Execution (910729)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Publisher.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Publisher that could
allow arbitrary code to be run.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it open it.  Then a bug in the font parsing
handler would result in code execution.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Publisher 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: QuickTime < 7.1.3 Multiple Vulnerabilities (Windows)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote version of QuickTime is affected by multiple overflow
vulnerabilities.
plugins.description:
The remote Windows host is running a version of QuickTime prior to
7.1.3. 

The remote version of QuickTime is vulnerable to various integer and
buffer overflows involving specially crafted image and media files. 
An attacker may be able to leverage these issues to execute arbitrary
code on the remote host by sending a malformed file to a victim and
having him open it using QuickTime player.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to QuickTime version 7.1.3 or later.

plugins.name: MailEnable SMTP Connector Service SPF Record Crafted Lookup DoS
plugins.synopsis:
The remote SMTP server is affected by a denial of service
vulnerability.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running MailEnable, a commercial mail server for
Windows.

The SMTP server bundled with the version of MailEnable installed on
the remote host is affected by a flaw in which SPF lookups for domains
with large records may result in a NULL pointer exception in the SMTP
service. An unauthenticated, remote attacker can exploit this issue to
crash the affected service.
plugins.solution: Apply Hotfix ME-10014.

plugins.name: FeedDemon < 2.0.0.25 Atom Feed Active Script Code Execution
plugins.synopsis:
The remote Windows application may allow execution of arbitrary Active
Script code.
plugins.description:
According to the Windows registry, the version of FeedDemon, an RSS
reader for Windows, installed on the remote host is affected by a flaw
due to improper sanitization of RSS feeds of Active Script code. An
attacker can exploit this issue to inject arbitrary script into the
affected application, which can lead to various cross-site scripting
attacks.
plugins.solution: Upgrade to FeedDemon version 2.0.0.25 or later.

plugins.name: MS06-055: Vulnerability in Vector Markup Language Could Allow Remote Code Execution (925486)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the email client or
the web browser.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Internet Explorer or Outlook Express
that is vulnerable to a bug in the Vector Markup Language (VML) handling routine
that could allow an attacker execute arbitrary code on the remote host by sending
a specially crafted email or by luring a user on the remote host into visiting
a rogue website.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: ePolicy Orchestrator HTTP /spipe/pkg/ Source Header Remote Overflow
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host due to a flaw in the
web service.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running McAfee ePolicy Orchestrator web service.

The remote version of this software contains a stack overflow
vulnerability.

An unauthenticated attacker can exploit this flaw by sending a
specialy crafted packet to the remote host. A successful exploitation
of this vulnerability would result in remote code execution with
SYSTEM privileges.
plugins.solution: Install ePO 3.5.0 Patch 6.

plugins.name: MS06-056: Vulnerabilities in ASP.NET could allow information disclosure (922770)
plugins.synopsis:
The remote .Net Framework is vulnerable to a cross-site scripting
attack.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of the ASP.NET framework that
contains a cross-site scripting vulnerability that could allow an
attacker to execute arbitrary code in the browser of the users
visiting the remote website.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-057: Vulnerability in Windows Explorer Could Allow Remote Execution (923191)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web or
email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in the Windows Explorer WebViewFolderIcon ActiveX control (Web View).

An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the remote host
by constructing a malicious script and enticing a victim to visit a
website or view a specially crafted email message.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-058: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft PowerPoint Could Allow Remote Code Execution (924163)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
PowerPoint.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft PowerPoint that is
subject to a flaw that could allow arbitrary code to be run.

An attacker may use this to execute arbitrary code on this host.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it open it.  Then a bug in the font parsing
handler would result in code execution.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for PowerPoint 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-059: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Excel Could Allow Remote Code Execution (924164)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Excel.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Excel that may allow
arbitrary code to be run.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it open it with Microsoft Excel.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Excel 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-060: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Word Could Allow Remote Code Execution (924554)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Word.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Word that may allow
arbitrary code to be run.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
the remote computer and have it open it.  Then a bug in the font parsing
handler would result in code execution.
plugins.solution: Microsoft has released a set of patches for Word 2000, XP and 2003.

plugins.name: MS06-061: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft XML Core Services Could Allow Remote Code Execution (924191)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through the web or
email client.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Windows that contains a flaw
in the Windows XML Core Services.

An attacker may be able to execute arbitrary code on the remote host
by constructing a malicious script and enticing a victim to visit a
website or view a specially crafted email message.
plugins.solution:
Microsoft has released a set of patches for Windows 2000, XP and
2003.

plugins.name: MS06-062: Vulnerabilities in Microsoft Office Could Allow Remote Code Execution (922581)
plugins.synopsis:
Arbitrary code can be executed on the remote host through Microsoft
Office.
plugins.description:
The remote host is running a version of Microsoft Office that could
allow arbitrary code to be run.

To succeed, the attacker would have to send a rogue file to a user of
